select tab.Description, tab.SupplierName, tab.CurrencyName, Sum(tab.Amount) As Amount, tab.CustomerID, tab.ToNoOfDays from ( ---------- Purchase Invoice ---------- SELECT distinct SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, 'PKR' as CurrencyName, (select sum(NetAmount) from AR_InvoiceDetail where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status= 1
) * -1 as Amount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName in ('Vendor') WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId And (DATEDIFF(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) {0} union all ---------- Purchase Invoice Suppliers ---------- SELECT distinct SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, 'PKR' as CurrencyName, Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount else AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end as Amount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 inner JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName in ('Vendor') WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId And (DATEDIFF(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) and isnull(AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.narration,'') != 'GST' {0} union all ---------- Payments ---------- SELECT SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, 'PKR' as CurrencyName, case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%vendor invoice%' then sum(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) else Sum((Case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount else AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end)) end as Amount ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays FROM AP_PaymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader .DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader .CompanyID INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 INNER Join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID
And (DATEDIFF(day, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 1 and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%vendor invoice%' and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 {0} group by SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays ,AP_PaymentHeader .DocumentNo ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType
union all ---------- Payments Vendor Invoice ---------- SELECT SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, 'PKR' as CurrencyName,
Sum(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount) as Amount ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays FROM AP_PaymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader .DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader .CompanyID INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 INNER Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID
And (DATEDIFF(day, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 1 {0} and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%vendor invoice%' and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 group by SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays ,AP_PaymentHeader .DocumentNo ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType
-- union all -- ---------- Receipt ---------- -- SELECT SET_Bucket.Description, -- AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, -- SET_Currency.CurrencyName, -- Case when -- ( -- select Amount from AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail rad -- where rad.TransactionType = 'Credit' and rad.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID -- and rad.ReceiptAccountID = AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptAccountID -- ) is null then AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount * -1 else AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount * -1 end as Amount -- ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays -- FROM SET_DocumentType -- INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID -- AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID -- AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 -- INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID -- --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID -- AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID -- AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
-- INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID -- and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 -- and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 --INNER JOIN SET_Currency ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CurrencyId = SET_Currency.CurrencyID
-- INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID -- --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID -- AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
-- INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode -- Left Join AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail on AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID -- AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID -- AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID -- WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = @CompanyID
-- And (DATEDIFF(day, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays -- or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) -- and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 1 -- GROUP BY SET_Currency.CurrencyName,SET_Bucket.Description,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID, -- AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptAccountID,AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.Amount, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, -- AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, Comments, ReversalComments -- ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays )as Tab INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = Tab.CustomerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 1
Group By tab.Description, tab.SupplierName, tab.CurrencyName, tab.CustomerID, tab.ToNoOfDays
Order by tab.ToNoOfDays asc
------------ Get Sum of Sales Invoice & Payment to knock off from Purchase Invoice & Receipt ---------- --Select FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.SupplierName, Abs(Sum(IsNull(FinTab.Amount, 0))) As Amount From --( -- ---------- Sale Invoice Header ---------- -- SELECT AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, IsNull(Sum(SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid), 0) as Amount -- FROM SAL_InvoiceHeader -- INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID -- --AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID -- AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID -- AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 -- INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID -- --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID -- AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID -- INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode -- AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Customer' -- WHERE SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 -- And SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 1 -- GROUP BY AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName
-- union all -- ---------- Payment ---------- -- SELECT AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, Sum(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) as Amount -- FROM AP_PaymentHeader -- INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID -- AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 -- INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID -- --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID -- AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID -- WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 -- and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 1 -- Group By AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName
-- union all -- ---------- Payment Suppliers ---------- -- SELECT AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, -- Sum((Case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount else AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end)) as Amount -- FROM AP_PaymentHeader -- INNER Join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID -- and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID -- INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID -- --AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID -- AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID -- AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 -- INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID -- --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID -- AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID -- WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 -- AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 1 -- Group By AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName --) As FinTab --Where FinTab.{0} --Group By FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.SupplierName

data.name: Query_AmountbyIMportID
data.value:
--Declare @CompanyID int = 2 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @ItemID int = 18792 --Declare @BLNumber varchar(50) = 'MEDUUK703558' --Declare @PODetailID int = 1
select sum(Amount) as Amount from (
select
SUM(isnull(Convert(decimal(18,2),t.NetAmount),0) ) as Amount from ( select distinct AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.NetAmount , Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.PODetailID from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader
--inner join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID --and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID --and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID
left join Fabric_ImportCostingHeader on Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.BL_Number = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.status = 1
left join Fabric_ImportCostingDetail on Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CostingID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CostingID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CompanyID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.PeriodID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.PeriodID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.Status = 1
left join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.ItemID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.PODetailID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1 inner join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemUOMID
where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=@CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.[PeriodID]=@PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber like @BLNumber and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode=1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = @ItemID AND (Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.PODetailID = @PODetailID OR @PODetailID IS NULL) )t
union all
select isnull( Sum(isnull(t.IncomeTax,0) + isnull(t.SalesTax,0) + isnull(t.AdditionalSalesTax,0)) ,0) * -1 as Amount from ( select distinct isnull(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.IncomeTax,0) as IncomeTax , isnull(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.SalesTax,0) as SalesTax , isnull(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.AdditionalSalesTax,0) as AdditionalSalesTax , Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CostingDetailID from Fabric_ImportCostingHeader left join Fabric_ImportCostingDetail on Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CostingID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CostingID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CompanyID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.PeriodID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.PeriodID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.status = 1 left join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.BL_Number and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.status = 1 left join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.ItemID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.PODetailID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1
where Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.Status = 1 and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.BL_Number like @BLNumber and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = @ItemID AND (Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.PODetailID = @PODetailID OR @PODetailID IS NULL) and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID )t
union all
select ((ISNULL( SUM((ISNULL(IMP_CustomClearing.GSTAmount,0)) + (ISNULL(Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.GSTAmount,0))) ,0)) /
((select count(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID) from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader
inner join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID
where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=@CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.[PeriodID]=@PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber like @BLNumber and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode=1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1))
)* -1 as Amount from Fabric_ImportCostingHeader left join IMP_CustomClearing on IMP_CustomClearing.BINumber = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.BL_Number and IMP_CustomClearing.Status = 1 left join Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading on Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.BINo = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.BL_Number and Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.Status = 1 where Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.Status = 1 and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.BL_Number like @BLNumber and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader .CompanyID = @CompanyID
union all
select Sum(isnull(t.CDAmount,0) + isnull(t.ACDAmount,0) + isnull(t.Panelty,0) + isnull(t.IncomeTax,0) + isnull(t.SalesTax,0) + isnull(t.AdditionalSalesTax,0) + isnull(t.RD,0) ) as Amount from ( select distinct isnull(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CDAmount,0) as CDAmount , isnull(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.ACDAmount,0) as ACDAmount , isnull(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.Panelty,0) as Panelty , isnull(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.IncomeTax,0) as IncomeTax , isnull(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.SalesTax,0) as SalesTax , isnull(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.AdditionalSalesTax,0) as AdditionalSalesTax , isnull(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.RD,0) as RD ,Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CostingDetailID
from Fabric_ImportCostingHeader left join Fabric_ImportCostingDetail on Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CostingID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CostingID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CompanyID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.PeriodID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.PeriodID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.Status = 1 left join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.BL_Number and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.status = 1 left join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.ItemID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.PODetailID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1 inner join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemUOMID
where Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.StatusCode=1 and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.status = 1 and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID=@CompanyID and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.BL_Number like @BLNumber and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = @ItemID AND (Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.PODetailID = @PODetailID OR @PODetailID IS NULL) )t
union all
select ((isnull(sum(IMP_CustomClearing.TotalAmount),0) + (ISNULL(SUM(IMP_CustomClearing.GSTAmount),0))) / ((select count(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID) from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader
inner join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID
where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=@CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.[PeriodID]=@PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber like @BLNumber and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode=1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1))
) as Amount from IMP_CustomClearing inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber = IMP_CustomClearing.BINumber and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = IMP_CustomClearing.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = IMP_CustomClearing.PeriodID inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Import%doc%' where IMP_CustomClearing.StatusCode=1 and IMP_CustomClearing.status = 1 and IMP_CustomClearing.CompanyID=@CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber like @BLNumber
union all
select isnull((sum(TotalTransAmount) + sum(GSTAmount)) / ((select count(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID) from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader
inner join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID
where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=@CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.[PeriodID]=@PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber like @BLNumber and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode=1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1)) ,0)
as Amount from Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber = Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.BINo and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading .CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading .PeriodID inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Import%doc%' where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber like @BLNumber and Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.StatusCode=1 and Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.status = 1 and Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.CompanyID=@CompanyID
union all
select isnull(sum(DirectLcExpense_Header.TotalAmount),0) / ((select count(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID) from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader
inner join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID
where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=@CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.[PeriodID]=@PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber like @BLNumber and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode=1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1))
as Amount from DirectLcExpense_Header inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber = DirectLcExpense_Header.BINumber and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = DirectLcExpense_Header.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = DirectLcExpense_Header.PeriodID inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Import%doc%'
where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.BLNumber like @BLNumber and DirectLcExpense_Header.StatusCode=1 and DirectLcExpense_Header.status = 1 and DirectLcExpense_Header.CompanyID=@CompanyID )as tab

data.name: Query_AmountFromInvoiceNo
data.value:
Select Case When isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid, 0) = 0 Then ( Select Sum(FinTab.InvoiceAmount) From ( Select IsNull(Sum(Case When AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount Else 0 End), 0) As InvoiceAmount From AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail where AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = @IID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.companyid = @CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.periodid = @PeriodID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.status = 1 Group By InvoiceHeaderID, InvoiceDetailAccountID
Union All
Select IsNull(Sum(Case When AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount Else 0 End), 0) As InvoiceAmount From AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = @IID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.companyid = @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.periodid = @PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.status = 1 Group By InvoiceHeaderID, InvoiceSupplierID ) As FinTab ) Else isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid, 0) End As AmountPaid From AR_InvoiceHeader Where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = @IID And AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1

data.name: Query_AuditReportsOfIncomeOrdinance2001
data.value:
Select Vendor as VendorName,CNICNumber,InvoiceHeaderID,InvoiceNumber,InvoiceDate,AccountCode,Description ,Aging,SUM(PurchaseAmount) as PurchaseAmount from ( Select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Vendor,CNICNumber,InvoiceHeaderID,InvoiceNumber,InvoiceDate,InventoryAccountCCID as AccountCode,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description ,DATEDIFF(DAY, InvoiceDate,GETDATE()) as Aging,AR_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount as PurchaseAmount from AR_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID=AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID =AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID AND INV_Item.CompanyID =AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.InventoryAccountCCID is not null
INNER JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID= INV_Item.InventoryAccountCCID
Where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID =@PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode=1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status=1 UNION ALL
Select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Vendor,CNICNumber,InvoiceHeaderID,InvoiceNumber ,InvoiceDate,AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID as AccountCode, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description,DATEDIFF(DAY, InvoiceDate,GETDATE()) as Aging ,AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount as PurchaseAmount from AR_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID=AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID INNER JOIN AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail ON AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID= AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID Where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID =@PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode=1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status=1 ) as fintab Where fintab.AccountCode=@AccountCode group by InvoiceHeaderID,InvoiceNumber,InvoiceDate,AccountCode,Description ,Aging,Vendor,CNICNumber

data.name: Query_CustomerAgeAnalysisReport
data.value:
select tab.DocumentType,tab.Description, tab.SupplierName, tab.CurrencyName, tab.InvoiceNumber, tab.invoiceDate,tab.Days, Sum(tab.InvoiceAmount) as InvoiceAmount, (abs(Sum(tab.Amount)) - sum(tab.PaymentAmount)) As Amount, sum(tab.PaymentAmount) as PaymentAmount, (abs(Sum(tab.Amount)) - sum(tab.PaymentAmount)) as Balance, tab.CustomerID, tab.ToNoOfDays from ( ---------- Sale Invoice ---------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, 'PKR' as CurrencyName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate, SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid * -1 as InvoiceAmount, SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid * -1 as Amount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays, datediff(day, SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate, getdate()) as Days, isnull(AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Amount, 0) as PaymentAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 {0} INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = @BusinessPartnerType OR @BusinessPartnerType IS NULL) left join AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail on AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 WHERE SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate <= @AsOnDate And (DATEDIFF(day, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) --AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID IS NULL) --and isnull(SAL_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) <> 1 --AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null and SAL_InvoiceHeader.status = 1
union all ---------- Sale Invoice Customer ---------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, 'PKR' as CurrencyName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate, Case when Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then sum(Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount) else sum(Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount) * -1 end as InvoiceAmount, Case when Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then sum(Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount) else sum(Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount) * -1 end as Amount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays, datediff(day, SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate, getdate()) as Days, isnull(AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Amount, 0) as PaymentAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 LEFT JOIN Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail on Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 {0} INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = @BusinessPartnerType OR @BusinessPartnerType IS NULL) LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
left join AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail on AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Status = 1
WHERE SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate <= @AsOnDate And (DATEDIFF(day, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) --AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID IS NULL) --and isnull(SAL_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) <> 1 --AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null and SAL_InvoiceHeader.status = 1
group by SET_Bucket.Description,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays,AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Amount ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType
union all -- Direct Receipt SELECT distinct SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, 'PKR' as CurrencyName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo as InvoiceNumber ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate as invoiceDate,0 as InvoiceAmount, isnull(sum(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount),0) * -1 as Amount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays , datediff(day,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,getdate()) as Days,isnull(sum(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount),0) as PaymentAmount FROM AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 {0} INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = @BusinessPartnerType OR @BusinessPartnerType IS NULL) Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID -- AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID IS NULL) WHERE AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 2 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalDate is null and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments is null group by SET_Bucket.Description,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName , AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType
union all -------- Receipt Suppliers ---------- SELECT distinct SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, 'PKR' as CurrencyName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo as InvoiceNumber ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate as invoiceDate, 0 as InvoiceAmount, 0 as Amount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays , datediff(day,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,getdate()) as Days, case AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then isnull(sum(AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount),0) *-1 when 'credit' then isnull(sum(AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount),0) else 0 end as PaymentAmount
FROM AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 INNER Join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 {0} INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = @BusinessPartnerType OR @BusinessPartnerType IS NULL) Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID --AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID IS NULL) WHERE AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 2 And (DATEDIFF(day, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) --and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalDate is null and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments is null group by SET_Bucket.Description,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName , AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays,AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType
)as Tab INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = Tab.CustomerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 2 Group By tab.Description, tab.SupplierName, tab.CurrencyName, tab.CustomerID, tab.ToNoOfDays ,tab.InvoiceNumber,tab.invoiceDate,tab.Days,tab.DocumentType

data.name: Query_CustomerAgingVendor
data.value:
Select * from ( select tab.DocumentType,tab.Description, tab.SupplierName, tab.CurrencyName, tab.InvoiceNumber, tab.invoiceDate,tab.Days, Sum(tab.InvoiceAmount) as InvoiceAmount, (abs(Sum(tab.Amount)) - sum(tab.PaymentAmount)) As Amount, convert(decimal, sum(tab.PaymentAmount)) as PaymentAmount, (abs(Sum(tab.InvoiceAmount)) - sum(tab.PaymentAmount)) as Balance, tab.CustomerID, tab.ToNoOfDays , tab.SourceID , tab.BrokerName, tab.BrokerID, tab.CostCenterID, tab.SOID from ( ---------- Sale Invoice ---------- SELECT distinct SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, 'PKR' as CurrencyName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate, max(SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid * -1) as InvoiceAmount, max(SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount * -1) as Amount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays, datediff(day, SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate, getdate()) as Days, --sum(isnull(AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Amount, 0)) as PaymentAmount , (select isnull(sum(AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetailinner.Amount),0) from AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetailinner inner join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.ReceiptTransactionID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetailinner.ReceiptHeaderID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetailinner.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetailinner.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.StatusCode = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.Status = 1
where AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetailinner.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID --and SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetailinner.status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.Status =1 ) as PaymentAmount, SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID as SOID , '' as SourceID ,AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerName as BrokerName ,AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerID as BrokerID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1
inner join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_OrderDetail on SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID and SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID and SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_OrderDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1 and (SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID) not in (select isnull(SourceHeaderID,0) from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader where CompanyID = @CompanyID and status = 1 and BusinessPartnerTypeID = 2)
INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 {0}
inner join AR_SET_Customer AR_SET_CustomerBroker on AR_SET_CustomerBroker.customerid = AR_SET_Customer.brokerid {1} INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = @BusinessPartnerType OR @BusinessPartnerType IS NULL) and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 2 left join AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail on AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 WHERE SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate <= @AsOnDate And (DATEDIFF(day, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID IS NULL) AND (SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID OR @DocumentTypeID IS NULL) --and isnull(SAL_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) <> 1 --AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null and SAL_InvoiceHeader.status = 1 group by SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays, datediff(day, SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate, getdate()) , SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID,AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID--,SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ,AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID,SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID union all ---------- Sale Invoice Customer ---------- select DocumentType, Description, getdate()) as Days, --isnull(AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Amount, 0) as PaymentAmount isnull((select isnull(AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Amount, 0) from AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetailinenr inner join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.ReceiptTransactionID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetailinenr.ReceiptHeaderID and PaymentAmount , '' as SOID , '' as SourceID ,AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerName as BrokerName ,AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerID as BrokerID , (select AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.CostCentreID from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.Status = 1 where AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetailinenr.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.ReceiptHeaderID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetailinenr.InvoiceHeaderID = data.value:
select *,( Case when (DocumentType like 'Sales%Invoice%' or DocumentType like 'DI%Customer%' ) then -- 0 isnull((select max(InvoiceHeaderID) from dbo.AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail where invoiceheaderid = FinalTAB.SourceID),SourceID) when DocumentType like 'Receipt%Against%' then --0 (select max(InvoiceHeaderID) from dbo.AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail where InvoiceHeaderID= FinalTAB.SourceID) --end
when (DocumentType like 'Advance Against SO%' or DocumentType like 'Direct%' )then --0 (select max(ReceiptTransactionID) from dbo.AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader where ReceiptTransactionID= FinalTAB.SourceID) end
)InvoiceGroup , (Case when DocumentType like '%(Op%' then 0 --When DocumentType like '%Direct%' --then 0 when (Reversal is not null) then -1 when (DocumentType like 'Sale%Invoice%' or DocumentType like 'DI%Customer%') then DocumentNo when (DocumentType like 'Advance Against SO%' or DocumentType like 'Direct%') then DocumentNo
else -1 end) GroupNo
from (
select * from (
SELECT FINTAB.DocumentType, Fintab.CreateDate, FINTAB.CustomerID, FINTAB.Name, FinTab.SourceID, SUM(FINTAB.Amount) as Amount, FINTAB.InstrumentNo, FINTAB.Comments, FINTAB.InvoiceNumbers, FINTAB.InvoiceDocumentNo, FINTAB.DocumentNo, FINTAB.DocumentDate, FINTAB.FreightAmount, FINTAB.ForAlhajAmount, FINTAB.GroupName,FINTAB.SalePerson,FINTAB.Reversal ,FINTAB.ReceiptTransactionID FROM ( SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType , SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS Name, ( CASE When [SAL_InvoiceHeader].ReversalID is not null then [SAL_InvoiceHeader].ReversalID else SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID end)as SourceID, case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Credit Note' then SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid * -1 else SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid end as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate,
CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount * -1, 0) else ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount, 0) end as FreightAmount , 0 As ForAlhajAmount,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,billto.CustomerName as SalePerson ,(CASE When [SAL_InvoiceHeader].ReversalID is not null then ' (R) ' + (select [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceNumber from [SAL_InvoiceHeader] Sal_Reverse where Sal_Reverse.InvoiceID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].ReversalID ) END ) as Reversal ,'' as ReceiptTransactionID FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 Left JOIN AR_SET_Customer billto ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid = billto.CustomerID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = billto.CompanyID INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Customer' LEFT JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightCode AND GL_TransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = @CompanyID -- AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID NOT IN (SELECT InvoiceHeaderID FROM Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail) GROUP BY SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].ReversalID,SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,billto.CustomerName
UNION ALL -----------Sale Invoice Header Detail Data----------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, ( CASE When [SAL_InvoiceHeader].ReversalID is not null then [SAL_InvoiceHeader].ReversalID else SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID end)as SourceID, case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Credit Note' then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount * -1 when [SAL_InvoiceHeader].ReversalID is not null then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount WHEN Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType='Debit' then sum(Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount) when Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType='Credit' then sum(Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount*-1) else Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount end as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount * -1, 0) else ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount, 0) end as FreightAmount , 0 As ForAlhajAmount,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,billto.CustomerName as SalePerson ,(CASE When [SAL_InvoiceHeader].ReversalID is not null then ' (R) ' + (select Sal_Reverse.InvoiceNumber from [SAL_InvoiceHeader] Sal_Reverse where Sal_Reverse.InvoiceID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].ReversalID ) END ) as Reversal ,'' as ReceiptTransactionID SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType inner join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail on Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 Left JOIN AR_SET_Customer billto ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid = billto.CustomerID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = billto.CompanyID INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Customer' LEFT JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightCode AND GL_TransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%(CN)%'
and [SAL_InvoiceHeader].ReversalID is null and isnull([SAL_InvoiceHeader].invoiceid,0) not in (select reversalid from [SAL_InvoiceHeader] where [SAL_InvoiceHeader].ReversalID is not null)
GROUP BY SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount,Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,billto.CustomerName,SAL_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID,Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType
