AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount *-1 end )) is null THEN AP_PaymentHeader.Amount else 0 end) as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, 0 as FreightAmount , 0 As ForAlhajAmount,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as SalePerson ,( CASE When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalDate is not null then ' (R) ' + (select Cast(AP_Reverse.DocumentNo as Varchar(100)) from AP_PaymentHeader AP_Reverse where AP_Reverse.PaymentID=AP_PaymentHeader.SourceHeaderID ) END ) as Reversal ,'' as ReceiptTransactionID FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Customer' inner Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' ---imt INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
GROUP BY AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType, AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID,AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID,AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments ,AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalDate,AP_PaymentHeader.SourceHeaderID ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName
UNION ALL
----------------------------- PAYMENT Imtiaz
--------------------------- SINGLE BUSINESS PARTNER CASE
SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID as SourceID, (Case when AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType is not null then AP_PaymentHeader.Amount * -1 else AP_PaymentHeader.Amount end) as Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo AS InstrumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments + (Case When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, 0 as FreightAmount , 0 As ForAlhajAmount,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as SalePerson ,( CASE When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalDate is not null then ' (R) ' + (select Cast(AP_Reverse.DocumentNo as Varchar(100)) from AP_PaymentHeader AP_Reverse where AP_Reverse.PaymentID=AP_PaymentHeader.SourceHeaderID ) END ) as Reversal ,'' as ReceiptTransactionID FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' inner Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And
INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode in (2) GROUP BY AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType, AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID,AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID,AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,AP_PaymentHeader.SourceHeaderID ,AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalDate
----------------------------- Imtiaz----
) AS FINTAB GROUP BY DocumentType, CreateDate, CustomerID, NAME, SourceID, InstrumentNo, Comments, InvoiceNumbers, InvoiceDocumentNo, DocumentNo, DocumentDate, FreightAmount, ForAlhajAmount,GroupName,FINTAB.SalePerson,FINTAB.Reversal,FINTAB.ReceiptTransactionID ) as TAb --------------Filter
) as FinalTAB ,AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes where FinalTAB.Amount <> 0 and FinalTAB.CustomerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID and TypeCode = 2 and (case when FinalTab.DocumentType like '%Receipt%Against%Invoices%' and finaltab.reversal is not null then 1 else 0 end ) = 0 {0} Order By FinalTAB.DocumentDate,FinalTAB.Name,FinalTAB.DocumentNo asc

data.name: Query_DirectInvoiceReport
data.value:
Select distinct Set_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType, isnull(Convert(Varchar, InvoiceDate, 105), 0) as InvoiceDate, InvoiceNumber, VendorReferenceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.Description as Narration, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1, (Case when AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 then 'Approved' when AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 5 then 'InProcess' when AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 12 then 'ReleaseForApprove' when AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 13 then 'PartiallyApproved' END) AS StatusCode, AmountPaid,VendorReferenceNumber as ReferenceNumber,Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName ,Set_Department.DepartmentName ,isnull((AR_InvoiceHeader.UpdatedByValue),AR_InvoiceHeader.CreatedByValue) as PreparedBy ,Case when AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode=1 then isnull(( select top 1 CreatedByValue from SET_DocumentApprove where Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber and Set_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID order by DocumentApproveID desc ),AR_InvoiceHeader.CreatedByValue) else '' end as ApprovedBy From AR_InvoiceHeader
left join AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
left join AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail on AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.status=1 left Join Set_CostCenter ON Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CostCenterID And Set_CostCenter.Status = 1 left Join Set_Department ON Set_Department.DepartmentID = AR_InvoiceHeader.DepartmentID And Set_Department.Status = 1 left Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID left Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId left Join AR_Set_Customer ON AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID --AND AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID AND AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID AND AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0}
-- Supplier Detail Select distinct Set_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceSupplierID, isnull(Convert(Varchar, InvoiceDate, 105), 0) as InvoiceDate, InvoiceNumber, VendorReferenceNumber,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Narration,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceSupplierID
From AR_InvoiceHeader
Left join AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
left Join AR_Set_Customer ON AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID --AND AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID AND AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID AND AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0} ORDER by AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceSupplierID asc
-- Account Detail Select distinct Set_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType,AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceDetailAccountID, isnull(Convert(Varchar, InvoiceDate, 105), 0) as InvoiceDate, InvoiceNumber, AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID, gl_codeCombinationDetail.Description as ExpenceCode,
AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.amount , AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.TransactionType ,AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Narration, AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceDetailAccountID From AR_InvoiceHeader
inner join AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail on AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.status=1 inner join gl_codeCombinationDetail on gl_codeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID
left Join Set_CostCenter ON Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CostCenterID And Set_CostCenter.Status = 1 left Join Set_Department ON Set_Department.DepartmentID = AR_InvoiceHeader.DepartmentID And Set_Department.Status = 1
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0} ORDER by AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceDetailAccountID asc -- GL Detail select * from ( -- Supplier Detail Select distinct Set_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType, InvoiceNumber,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode as GLCode, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName as Description, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Narration,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceSupplierID
From AR_InvoiceHeader
inner join AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1
Left Join AR_Set_Customer ON AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID --AND AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID AND AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID AND AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0}
union all -- Account Detail Select distinct Set_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType, InvoiceNumber, AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID as GLCode, gl_codeCombinationDetail.Description , AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.amount , AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.TransactionType ,AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Narration ,AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceDetailAccountID From AR_InvoiceHeader inner join AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail on AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.status=1
inner join gl_codeCombinationDetail on gl_codeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID
left Join Set_CostCenter ON Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CostCenterID And Set_CostCenter.Status = 1 left Join Set_Department ON Set_Department.DepartmentID = AR_InvoiceHeader.DepartmentID And Set_Department.Status = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0}
union all
-- Doc Type Select distinct Set_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType, InvoiceNumber,Set_DocumentType.Defaultaccountcode as GLCode, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description as Description, AR_InvoiceHeader.amountpaid as amount,'Debit' as TransactionType,'' as Narration,AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceid as InvoiceDetailAccountID
From AR_InvoiceHeader
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = Set_DocumentType.Defaultaccountcode and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0}
union all --Sales Tax
Select distinct Set_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType, InvoiceNumber,INV_Item.PurchasingTaxCCID as GLCode, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description as Description, AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmountOnNet as amount,'Debit' as TransactionType,'' as Narration,AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceid
From AR_InvoiceHeader
inner join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
inner join INV_Item on inv_item.itemid = AR_InvoiceDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.Status = 1
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = INV_Item.PurchasingTaxCCID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0}
union all
--Advance
Select distinct Set_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType, InvoiceNumber,AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID as GLCode, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description as Description, AR_InvoiceHeader.GrossAmount as Amount,'Credit' as TransactionType,'' as Narration,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID as InvoiceSupplierID
From AR_InvoiceHeader
inner Join AR_Set_Customer ON AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID --AND AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID AND AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
--inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_InvoiceHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0}
) as TAB order by TAB.TransactionType desc

data.name: Query_GetData_byKey_FromInvoice
data.value:
SELECT distinct -1 as RowUniqueID, AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentInvoicesID, AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID, AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber AS InvoiceNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,-- AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Amount AS InvoiceAmount, AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid + ( isnull((select sum(isnull(Amount,0)) from AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Narration not like 'GST' Group By AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID ),0) )
+ isnull(( (select sum(isnull(Convert(decimal(18,6),TaxAmountOnNet),0)) from AR_InvoiceDetail where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 Group By AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID, AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID, AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID ) ),0) AS InvoiceAmount, AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid + ( isnull((select sum(isnull(Amount,0)) from AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Narration not like 'GST' Group By AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID ),0) ) AS GrossAmount,
AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid + ( isnull((select sum(isnull(Amount,0)) from AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Narration not like 'GST' Group By AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID ),0) )
+ ( isnull((select sum(isnull(Convert(decimal(18,6),TaxAmountOnNet),0)) from AR_InvoiceDetail where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 Group By AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID, AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID, AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID ),0) ) - isnull((select sum(AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Amount) as Amount from AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail inner join AP_PaymentHeader on AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 where AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Status = 1),0)
as BalanceAmount
,AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Amount, isnull((select sum(isnull(Convert(decimal(18,6),TaxAmountOnNet),0)) from AR_InvoiceDetail where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 Group By AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID, AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID, AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID ),0) as TaxAmount, AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.SourceTypeID ,'' AS Action FROM AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1
left join AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail on AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
WHERE AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = @PaymentHeaderID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 --and AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.FiscalID

data.name: Query_GetInvoiceHeaderDataByKey
data.value:
select distinct ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY InvoiceID asc) RowUniqueID, * from ( SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID, InvoiceID, AcctsPayCodeCombinationID, AmountApplicableToDiscount,
case when (select sum(isnull(Amount,0)) from AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID Group By AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID ) > 0 AND (ISNULL(AmountPaid + ISNULL(FreightAmount,0) - ISNULL(OtherAmount,0),0) - (case when AR_Invoice_AccountsDetailOuter.TransactionType = 'Credit' then (Select Sum(isnull(AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount,0)) as Amount From AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail Where AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Status = 1 Group By AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID, AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID,AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID )

(Select Sum(isnull(AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount,0)) as Amount From AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail Where AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Status = 1 Group By AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID, AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID,AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID )

+ ( select isnull(sum(isnull(Amount,0)) ,0) from AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Narration='GST' )

then

--where AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceID -- and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID -- and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID -- ) - (case when AR_Invoice_AccountsDetailOuter.TransactionType = 'Credit' then (Select Sum(isnull(AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount,0)) as Amount From AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail Where AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Status = 1 Group By AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID, AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID,AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID ) else 0 end)

-( select isnull(sum(isnull(Amount,0)) ,0) from AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' )
),0) when (select sum(isnull(Amount,0)) from AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID Group BY AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID ,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID ) > 0 then Round((ISNUll((Case When AR_InvoiceSupplierDetailOuter.TransactionType ='Debit' then ( select sum(isnull(Amount,0)) from AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID Group By AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID ) else 0 end ),0) + ISNULL(FreightAmount,0) - ISNULL(OtherAmount,0) - isnull( ( select distinct top 1 isnull(GL_TransactionDetail.Amount, 0) from AR_InvoiceHeader AR inner join set_DocumentType on set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR.invoiceType and set_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Debit Note' inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AR.InvoiceType and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = ar.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = ar.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AR.InvoiceNumber inner join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = ar.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = ar.PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' where AR.VendorID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID ), 0) - ( select isnull(sum(AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Amount),0) from AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail inner join Ap_paymentHeader inv_hdr on inv_hdr.PaymentID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID AND inv_hdr.Status=1 and inv_hdr.StatusCode = 1 and inv_hdr.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID and inv_hdr.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID and inv_hdr.ReversalDate is null and ReversalID is null --AND MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu where MenuPath in ('/AP/Transaction/Payment.aspx','/AP/Transaction/DirectInvoicePayment.aspx'))
where AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.status = 1 )
),0) else
Round((ISNUll(AmountPaid,0) + ISNULL(FreightAmount,0) - ISNULL(OtherAmount,0) - isnull( ( select distinct top 1 isnull(GL_TransactionDetail.Amount, 0) from AR_InvoiceHeader AR inner join set_DocumentType on set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR.invoiceType and set_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Debit Note' inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AR.InvoiceType and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = ar.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = ar.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AR.InvoiceNumber inner join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = ar.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = ar.PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' where AR.VendorID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID ), 0) - ( select isnull(sum(AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Amount),0) from AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail inner join Ap_paymentHeader inv_hdr on inv_hdr.PaymentID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID AND inv_hdr.Status=1 and inv_hdr.StatusCode = 1 and inv_hdr.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID and inv_hdr.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID and inv_hdr.ReversalDate is null and ReversalID is null --AND MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu where MenuPath in ('/AP/Transaction/Payment.aspx','/AP/Transaction/DirectInvoicePayment.aspx'))

as AmountPaid, ApprovalDescription, ApprovalStatus, ApprovedAmount, AuthorizedBy, AutoTaxCalculationFlag, AutoWithholdingTaxFlag, AutoWithholdingTaxGroupID, BatchID, CancelledAmount, CancelledBy, CancelledDate, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreatedBy, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreatedByValue, AR_InvoiceHeader.Description, DiscountAmountTaken, DocumentSequenceID, EarliestSettlementDate, ExchangeDate, ExchangeRate, ExchangeRateType, ExclusivePaymentFlag, FreightAmount, GLPostingDate, GoodsReceivedDate, GrossAmount, InvoiceCurrencyID, InvoiceDate, InvoiceNumber, InvoiceReceivedDate, InvoiceType, PayCurrencyInvoiceAmount, PaymentGroupType, PaymentCrossRate, PaymentCrossRateDate, PaymentCrossRateType, PaymentCurrencyID, PaymentMethodType, PaymentStatusType, PostingStatus, RecurringPaymentID, TaxAmount, TermsDate, TermsID, AR_InvoiceHeader.UpdatedBy, AR_InvoiceHeader.UpdateDate, AR_InvoiceHeader.UpdatedByValue, VATCode, VendorID, VendorSiteID, VoucherNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.Status, VendorReferenceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode, AR_InvoiceHeader.CostCenterID, AR_InvoiceHeader.DepartmentID, ExpenseAccountCCID, AR_InvoiceHeader.IncurredOnID, LoanHeaderID, IsPaymentCompleted, IsIncurredOnAsset, AR_InvoiceHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID, OtherAmount, OtherChartOfAccountID, OtherCCID, AR_InvoiceHeader.TransactionType, AR_InvoiceHeader.LocationID, WithHeldTax, WithHeldCCID, GroupID , ( select top 1 AP_POPaymentSchedule.Date from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader inner join AP_POPaymentSchedule on AP_POPaymentSchedule.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and AP_POPaymentSchedule.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_POPaymentSchedule.status = 1
inner join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID
inner join Inv_StockTransactionDetail on Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID AND Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID AND Inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID
inner join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and AR_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AP_POPaymentSchedule.IsAdvance = 0 ) as PaymentDueDate FROM AR_InvoiceHeader inner join set_DocumentType on set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
left join AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail AR_Invoice_AccountsDetailOuter on AR_Invoice_AccountsDetailOuter.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetailOuter.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetailOuter.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetailOuter.Status = 1
Left Join AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail AR_InvoiceSupplierDetailOuter on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetailOuter.InvoiceHeaderID =AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetailOuter.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetailOuter.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetailOuter.Status = 1
WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = @InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID ) as TAb

data.name: Query_GetInvoiceHeaderDataByKeyForDI
data.value:
select distinct ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY InvoiceID asc) RowUniqueID,* from ( SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID, InvoiceID, AcctsPayCodeCombinationID, AmountApplicableToDiscount, AR_InvoiceHeader.CostCenterID,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, sum(AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount) as ActualInvoiceAmount, sum(AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount)
- isnull( ( select distinct top 1 isnull(GL_TransactionDetail.Amount, 0) from AR_InvoiceHeader AR inner join set_DocumentType on set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR.invoiceType and set_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Debit Note' inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AR.InvoiceType and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = ar.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = ar.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AR.InvoiceNumber inner join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = ar.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = ar.PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' where AR.VendorID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID ), 0)
-- Already Paid (Partial Case) - ( select isnull(sum(AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Amount),0) from AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail inner join Ap_paymentHeader inv_hdr on inv_hdr.PaymentID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID and inv_hdr.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID and inv_hdr.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID and inv_hdr.ReversalDate is null and ReversalID is null
where AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 ) as AmountPaid
,InvoiceDate, InvoiceNumber, InvoiceReceivedDate
FROM AR_InvoiceHeader inner join set_DocumentType on set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID inner join AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 left Join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID=AR_InvoiceHeader.CostCenterID And SET_CostCenter.Status=1
WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = @InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
group by InvoiceDate, InvoiceNumber, InvoiceReceivedDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID ,AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID, InvoiceID, AcctsPayCodeCombinationID, AmountApplicableToDiscount ,AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID,AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID,AR_InvoiceHeader.CostCenterID,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName ) as TAb

GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = ar.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = ar.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AR.InvoiceNumber inner join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = ar.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = ar.PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' where AR.VendorID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID ), 0) as AmountPaid, ApprovalDescription, ApprovalStatus, ApprovedAmount, AuthorizedBy, AutoTaxCalculationFlag, AutoWithholdingTaxFlag, AutoWithholdingTaxGroupID, BatchID, CancelledAmount, CancelledBy, CancelledDate, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreatedBy, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreatedByValue, AR_InvoiceHeader.Description, DiscountAmountTaken, DocumentSequenceID, EarliestSettlementDate, ExchangeDate, ExchangeRate, ExchangeRateType, ExclusivePaymentFlag, FreightAmount, GLPostingDate, GoodsReceivedDate, GrossAmount, InvoiceCurrencyID, InvoiceDate, InvoiceNumber, InvoiceReceivedDate, InvoiceType, PayCurrencyInvoiceAmount, PaymentGroupType, PaymentCrossRate, PaymentCrossRateDate, PaymentCrossRateType, PaymentCurrencyID, PaymentMethodType, PaymentStatusType, PostingStatus, RecurringPaymentID, TaxAmount, TermsDate, TermsID, AR_InvoiceHeader.UpdatedBy, AR_InvoiceHeader.UpdateDate, AR_InvoiceHeader.UpdatedByValue, VATCode, VendorID, VendorSiteID, VoucherNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.Status, VendorReferenceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode, AR_InvoiceHeader.CostCenterID, AR_InvoiceHeader.DepartmentID, ExpenseAccountCCID, AR_InvoiceHeader.IncurredOnID, LoanHeaderID, IsPaymentCompleted, IsIncurredOnAsset, BusinessPartnerTypeID, OtherAmount, OtherChartOfAccountID, OtherCCID, AR_InvoiceHeader.TransactionType, AR_InvoiceHeader.LocationID, WithHeldTax, WithHeldCCID FROM AR_InvoiceHeader inner join set_DocumentType on set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = @InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID ) as TAb

data.name: Query_GetSalesInvoiceForCUstomer
data.value:
--declare @CompanyID int = 1 , @PEriodID int = 1 ,@CurrentFiscalID int = 2
Select distinct Set_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType, isnull(Convert(Varchar, InvoiceDate, 105), 0) as InvoiceDate, InvoiceNumber, '' VendorReferenceNumber, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Description as Narration, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1, (Case when SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 then 'Approved' when SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 5 then 'InProcess' when SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 12 then 'ReleaseForApprove' when SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 13 then 'PartiallyApproved' END) AS StatusCode, AmountPaid, '' as ReferenceNumber,Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName ,'' DepartmentName ,isnull((SAL_InvoiceHeader.UpdatedByValue),SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreatedByValue) as PreparedBy ,Case when SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode=1 then isnull(( select top 1 CreatedByValue from SET_DocumentApprove where Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber and Set_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID order by DocumentApproveID desc ),SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreatedByValue) else '' end as ApprovedBy From SAL_InvoiceHeader
left join SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail on SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
left join Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail on Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.status=1 left Join Set_CostCenter ON Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CostCentreID And Set_CostCenter.Status = 1 left Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID left Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId left Join AR_Set_Customer ON AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID--AND AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID AND AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID AND AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0}
-- Supplier Detail Select distinct Set_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName,SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceCustomerID, isnull(Convert(Varchar, InvoiceDate, 105), 0) as InvoiceDate, InvoiceNumber, '' VendorReferenceNumber,SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount,SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType,SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Narration,SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceCustomerID
From SAL_InvoiceHeader
left join SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail on SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
left Join AR_Set_Customer ON AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID --AND AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID AND AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID AND AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0} --ORDER by SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID asc
-- Account Detail Select distinct Set_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType,Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceDetailAccountID, isnull(Convert(Varchar, InvoiceDate, 105), 0) as InvoiceDate, InvoiceNumber, Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID, gl_codeCombinationDetail.Description as ExpenceCode,
Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.amount , Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.TransactionType ,Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Narration, Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceDetailAccountID From SAL_InvoiceHeader
inner join Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail on Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.status=1 inner join gl_codeCombinationDetail on gl_codeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID
left Join Set_CostCenter ON Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CostCentreID And Set_CostCenter.Status = 1
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0} ORDER by Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceDetailAccountID asc -- GL Detail select * from ( -- Supplier Detail Select distinct Set_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType, InvoiceNumber,SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode as GLCode, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName as Description, SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount,SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType,SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Narration,SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceCustomerID
From SAL_InvoiceHeader
inner join SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail on SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
Left Join AR_Set_Customer ON AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID --AND AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID AND AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID AND AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0}
union all -- Account Detail Select distinct Set_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType, InvoiceNumber, Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID as GLCode, gl_codeCombinationDetail.Description , Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.amount , Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.TransactionType ,Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Narration ,Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceDetailAccountID From SAL_InvoiceHeader inner join Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail on Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.status=1
inner join gl_codeCombinationDetail on gl_codeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID
left Join Set_CostCenter ON Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CostCentreID And Set_CostCenter.Status = 1
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0}
) as TAB order by TAB.TransactionType desc

data.name: Query_GrossAmountByImportID
data.value: select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.NetAmount from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID=@importID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID=@PODetailID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status=1 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=@CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID=@PeriodID --and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID=@FiscalID

data.name: Query_OtherByImportID
data.value: select IMP_LogisticServices.TotalLogisticCost as LogisticAmount ,IMP_CustomClearing.TotalAmount as ClearingAmount ,Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.TotalTransAmount as TransportAmount ,Fabrics_LoadingAndUnloading.TotalUnloadAmount as LoadUnLoadAmount ,(select SUM(ISNULL(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CDAMount,0))+SUM(ISNULL(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.ACDAmount,0)) +SUM(ISNULL(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.Panelty,0))+SUM(ISNULL(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.IncomeTax,0))+SUM(ISNULL(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.InsuranceRate,0)) +SUM(ISNULL(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.SalesTax,0))+SUM(ISNULL(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.AdditionalSalesTax,0))+SUM(ISNULL(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.RD,0)) - SUM(ISNULL(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.InsuranceRate,0)) as GDAmount from Fabric_ImportCostingDetail where Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CostingID=IMP_CustomClearing.CostingID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CompanyID=IMP_LogisticServices.CompanyID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.PeriodID=IMP_LogisticServices.PeriodID) as GDAmount ,(select --Sum(Quantity) as TQty,ISNULL(Sum(SecondaryQuantity), 0) as Qty,Sum(NetAmount) as NetAmount, Sum((NetAmount)) as GrossPKR from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode where SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Import%doc%' and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=IMP_LogisticServices.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.[PeriodID]=IMP_LogisticServices.PeriodID --and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID=@FiscalID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID=IMP_LogisticServices.ImportDocumentID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode=1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 ) as ImportAmount from IMP_LogisticServices inner join Fabric_ImportCostingHeader on Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.StockTransactionID=IMP_LogisticServices.ImportDocumentID and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID=IMP_LogisticServices.CompanyID and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.PeriodID=IMP_LogisticServices.PeriodID and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.Status=1 and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.StatusCode=1 inner join IMP_CustomClearing on IMP_CustomClearing.CostingID=Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CostingID and IMP_CustomClearing.Status=1 and IMP_CustomClearing.StatusCode=1 inner join Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading on Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.ImportDocumentID=IMP_CustomClearing.CostingID and Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.Status=1 and Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.StatusCode=1 inner join Fabrics_LoadingAndUnloading on Fabrics_LoadingAndUnloading.ImportDocumentID=Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.ImportDocumentID and Fabrics_LoadingAndUnloading.Status=1 and Fabrics_LoadingAndUnloading.StatusCode=1 where IMP_LogisticServices.ImportDocumentID=@importID and IMP_LogisticServices.CompanyID=@CompanyID and IMP_LogisticServices.PeriodID=@PeriodID and IMP_LogisticServices.Status=1 and IMP_LogisticServices.StatusCode=1

data.name: Query_OtherByImportIDByItem
data.value:
select ISNULL(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.NetAmount,0) as InvoiceAmount ,(ISNULL(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CDAMount,0) + ISNULL(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.ACDAmount,0) + ISNULL(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.Panelty,0) +ISNULL(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.IncomeTax,0) +ISNULL(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.InsuranceRate,0) +ISNULL(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.SalesTax,0) +ISNULL(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.AdditionalSalesTax,0) +ISNULL(Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.RD,0) ) as TotalCDs ,Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.ItemID
,(select Sum((NetAmount)) as GrossPKR from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode where SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Import%doc%' and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.[PeriodID]=Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID=Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.StockTransactionID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode=1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 ) as ImportAmount
,'' as LogisticAmount ,'' as ClearingAmount ,'' as TransportAmount ,'' as LoadUnLoadAmount ,'' as GDAmount
from Fabric_ImportCostingHeader inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID=Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.StockTransactionID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID=Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.PeriodID
inner join AP_PurchaseOrderDetail on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode
inner join Fabric_ImportCostingDetail on Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CostingID=Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CostingID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.ItemID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID
where SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Import%doc%' and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=@CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.[PeriodID]=@PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID=@importID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode=1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CompanyID=@CompanyID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.PeriodID=@PeriodID and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID=@CompanyID and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.PeriodID=@PeriodID and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.Status=1 and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.StatusCode=1 and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.ItemID = @ItemID

data.name: Query_OtherValuesByImportID
data.value: select ISNULL(IMP_LogisticServices.TotalLogisticCost + IMP_CustomClearing.TotalInvoiceAmount + Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.TotalTransAmount + Fabrics_LoadingAndUnloading.TotalUnloadAmount,0) as TotalAmount from IMP_LogisticServices inner join Fabric_ImportCostingHeader on Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.StockTransactionID=IMP_LogisticServices.ImportDocumentID and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID=IMP_LogisticServices.CompanyID and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.PeriodID=IMP_LogisticServices.PeriodID and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.Status=1 and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.StatusCode=1 inner join IMP_CustomClearing on IMP_CustomClearing.CostingID=Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CostingID and IMP_CustomClearing.Status=1 and IMP_CustomClearing.StatusCode=1 inner join Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading on Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.ImportDocumentID=IMP_CustomClearing.CostingID and Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.Status=1 and Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.StatusCode=1 inner join Fabrics_LoadingAndUnloading on Fabrics_LoadingAndUnloading.ImportDocumentID=Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.ImportDocumentID and Fabrics_LoadingAndUnloading.Status=1 and Fabrics_LoadingAndUnloading.StatusCode=1 where IMP_LogisticServices.ImportDocumentID=@importID and IMP_LogisticServices.CompanyID=@CompanyID and IMP_LogisticServices.PeriodID=@PeriodID and IMP_LogisticServices.Status=1 and IMP_LogisticServices.StatusCode=1

data.name: Query_PayableAgingVendor
data.value:
select a.DocumentType, a.Description, a.SupplierName, a.CurrencyName, a.InvoiceNumber, a.invoiceDate, a.Days, InvoiceAmount, Amount, PaymentAmount,(abs(InvoiceAmount) - abs(PaymentAmount)) Balance, a.CustomerID, a.ToNoOfDays from ( select tab.DocumentType, tab.Description, tab.SupplierName, tab.CurrencyName, tab.InvoiceNumber, tab.invoiceDate, tab.Days, Sum(tab.InvoiceAmount) as InvoiceAmount, (abs(Sum(tab.Amount)) - sum(tab.PaymentAmount)) As Amount, sum(tab.PaymentAmount) as PaymentAmount, case when (tab.DocumentType like '%payment%' or tab.DocumentType like '%advance%') And Sum(Tab.PaymentAmount) > 0 then case (abs(Sum(tab.Amount)) - sum(tab.PaymentAmount)) when 0 then sum(tab.PaymentAmount) else (abs(Sum(tab.Amount)) - sum(tab.PaymentAmount)) end else case when (abs(Sum(tab.Amount)) - sum(tab.PaymentAmount)) > 0 then (abs(Sum(tab.Amount)) - sum(tab.PaymentAmount)) * -1 else (abs(Sum(tab.Amount)) - sum(tab.PaymentAmount)) end end as Balance, tab.CustomerID, tab.ToNoOfDays from ( ---------- Purchase Invoice ---------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, 'PKR' as CurrencyName, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate, (AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid - AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherAmount) * -1 as InvoiceAmount, (AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid - AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherAmount) * -1 as Amount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays, datediff(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate, @AsOnDate) as Days, isnull(sum(case ap_paymentHeader.statuscode when 1 then ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.Amount else 0 end), 0) as PaymentAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 {0} INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_InvoiceHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID or AR_InvoiceHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID is null) AND (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = @BusinessPartnerType OR @BusinessPartnerType IS NULL) LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName in ('Vendor') left join ap_paymentInvoicesDetail on ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.status = 1 left join ap_paymentHeader on ap_paymentHeader.PaymentID = ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID and ap_paymentHeader.CompanyID = ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID and ap_paymentHeader.PeriodID = ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID -- inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate --and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate <= @AsOnDate And (DATEDIFF(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, @AsOnDate) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, @AsOnDate) >= FromNoOfDays)) and AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null and AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalDate is null AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID IS NULL) group by SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate, AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid, AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherAmount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType
union all ---------- Purchase Invoice Suppliers ---------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, 'PKR' as CurrencyName, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate, Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then sum(AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount) else sum(AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount) * -1 end as InvoiceAmount, Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then sum(AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount) else sum(AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount) * -1 end as Amount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays, datediff(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate, @AsOnDate) as Days, isnull(sum(ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.Amount), 0) as PaymentAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 {0} INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID or AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID is null) AND (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = @BusinessPartnerType OR @BusinessPartnerType IS NULL) LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode left join ap_paymentInvoicesDetail on ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.status= 1 -- inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate --and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate <= @AsOnDate And (DATEDIFF(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, @AsOnDate) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, @AsOnDate) >= FromNoOfDays)) and AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null and AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalDate is null AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID IS NULL) group by select fintab.DocumentType, fintab.SupplierName, fintab.CurrencyName,abs(Sum(fintab.InvoiceAmount)) as InvoiceAmount, abs(abs(Sum(fintab.Amount)) - sum(fintab.PaymentAmount)) As Amount, sum(fintab.PaymentAmount) as PaymentAmount, case when (fintab.DocumentType like '%payment%' or fintab.DocumentType like '%advance%') And Sum(fintab.PaymentAmount) > 0 then case (abs(Sum(fintab.Amount)) - sum(fintab.PaymentAmount)) when 0 then sum(fintab.PaymentAmount) else (abs(Sum(fintab.Amount)) - sum(fintab.PaymentAmount)) end else case when (abs(Sum(fintab.Amount)) - sum(fintab.PaymentAmount)) > 0 then (abs(Sum(fintab.Amount)) - sum(fintab.PaymentAmount)) * -1 else (abs(Sum(fintab.Amount)) - abs(sum(fintab.PaymentAmount))) end end as Balance from ( select tab.DocumentType, tab.Description, tab.SupplierName, tab.CurrencyName, tab.InvoiceNumber, tab.invoiceDate, tab.Days, Sum(tab.InvoiceAmount) as InvoiceAmount, (abs(Sum(tab.Amount)) - sum(tab.PaymentAmount)) As Amount, sum(tab.PaymentAmount) as PaymentAmount, case when (tab.DocumentType like '%payment%' or tab.DocumentType like '%advance%') And Sum(Tab.PaymentAmount) > 0 then case (abs(Sum(tab.Amount)) - sum(tab.PaymentAmount)) when 0 then sum(tab.PaymentAmount) else (abs(Sum(tab.Amount)) - sum(tab.PaymentAmount)) end else case when (abs(Sum(tab.Amount)) - sum(tab.PaymentAmount)) > 0 then (abs(Sum(tab.Amount)) - sum(tab.PaymentAmount)) * -1 else (abs(Sum(tab.Amount)) - sum(tab.PaymentAmount)) end end as Balance, tab.CustomerID, tab.ToNoOfDays from ( ---------- Purchase Invoice ---------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, 'PKR' as CurrencyName, AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherAmount) * -1 as Amount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays, datediff(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate, @AsOnDate) as Days, isnull(sum(case ap_paymentHeader.statuscode when 1 then ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.Amount else 0 end), 0) as PaymentAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON = 1 {0} INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_InvoiceHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID or AR_InvoiceHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID is null) AND (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = @BusinessPartnerType OR @BusinessPartnerType IS NULL) LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName in ('Vendor') left join ap_paymentInvoicesDetail on ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.status = 1 left join ap_paymentHeader on ap_paymentHeader.PaymentID = ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID and ap_paymentHeader.CompanyID = ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID and ap_paymentHeader.PeriodID = ap_paymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate <= @AsOnDate And (DATEDIFF(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, @AsOnDate) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, @AsOnDate) >= FromNoOfDays)) and AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null and AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalDate is null AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID IS NULL) group by SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate, AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid, AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherAmount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType

DATEDIFF(day, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, @AsOnDate) >= FromNoOfDays)) and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID not in (select DocumentTypeID from set_documentType where DocumentType like '%Receipt Against Sale Invoice%') group by SET_Bucket.Description,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName , AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID IS NULL) inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and
