data.name: Query_PurchaseReportUnderSalesTaxAct1990
data.value:
Select Row_Number() Over(Order by AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber asc) as RowNumber, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as NTN,AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber as CNIC,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Supplier, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 as SupplierAddress, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo as NoteNumber , GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate as NoteDate, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType ,Sum(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount) - SUM((AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount * ISNULL(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0)) / 100) as ExcludingSalesTax ,Sum(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount) as InclusiveSalesTax ,SUM((AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount * ISNULL(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0)) / 100) as SaleTaxAmount ,SUM((AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount*ISNULL(OtherAmount,0))/100) as ExtraTaxes ,0 as Furthertax
from AR_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID =AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID =AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID=AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=AR_InvoiceHeader.INvoiceId AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1
--INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=AR_InvoiceDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.Status=1
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1
where AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode=1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate
group by AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber, AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType

data.name: Query_PurchaseReturnReportUnderSalesTaxAct1990
data.value:
Select Row_Number() OVER(Order by INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo asc) as RowNumber, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as NTN,AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber as CNIC,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Supplier, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 as SupplierAddress, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo as NoteNumber , GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate as NoteDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo as InvoiceNumber, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate as InvoiceDate ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType ,ABS(Sum(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) - Sum(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.salestax,0))) as ExcludingSalesTax ,ABS(Sum(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0))) as InclusiveSalesTax ,ABS(Sum(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.salestax,0))) as SaleTaxAmount ,0 as ExtraTaxes ,0 as Furthertax
from INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1
where SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%purchase%return%' and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode=1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate
group by AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber, AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType

data.name: Query_Report_APBillReport
data.value:
select InvoiceType, Comments, InvoiceDate, InvoiceDateMin, InvoiceNumber, VendorID, CustomerName, sum(GrossAmount) as GrossAmount,OtherTax,OtherAmount, sum(TaxAmount) TaxAmount, sum(NetAmount) NetAmount, PaymentTerms, GRN, PurchaseOrderNumber, VendorReferenceNumber, Status, ( SELECT isnull(sum(Round(ARINVD.Amount, 2)), 0) FROM AR_InvoiceHeader ARINVH left JOIN AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail ARINVD ON ARINVD.InvoiceHeaderID = ARINVH.InvoiceID AND ARINVD.CompanyID = ARINVH.CompanyID AND ARINVD.PeriodID = ARINVH.PeriodID AND ARINVD.Status = 1 WHERE ARINVH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND ARINVH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND ARINVH.[Status] = 1 AND ARINVH.StatusCode = 1 AND ARINVH.InvoiceDate <= FINTAB.InvoiceDateMin AND ARINVH.VendorID = FINTAB.VendorID AND ARINVH.InvoiceType in ( SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID FROM SET_DocumentType where SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (SELECT MenuID FROM ApplicationMenu where MenuPath = '/AR/Transaction/Invoice_Transaction_frm.aspx') AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'DI-opening' ) ) as 'Opening' ,AdvanceAmount from ( SELECT AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AS InvoiceTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, MIN(AR_INVH.InvoiceDate) as InvoiceDateMin, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID, C.CustomerName, SET_Currency.CurrencyName,
case when AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount is not null then case when isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID,0) = 1 then Round(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount, 2) *-1 else Round(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount, 2) end
else case when isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID,0) = 1 then Round(AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount, 2) *-1 else Round(AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount, 2) end
end as GrossAmount,
Isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherAmount,0) as OtherTax ,ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount,0) as OtherAmount
--,ISNULL(((Round(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount, 2) * isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, 0))) / 100, 0) as TaxAmount,
,case when isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID,0) = 1 then ISNULL(((Round(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount, 2) * isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, 0))) / 100, 0) *-1 else ISNULL(((Round(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount, 2) * isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, 0))) / 100, 0) end as TaxAmount,
(Case when AR_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount is not null then
case when isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID,0) = 1 then AR_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount *-1 else AR_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount end
else AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount end) as NetAmount,
SET_Term.Description As [PaymentTerms], [Source] as 'GRN', AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber AS PurchaseOrderNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber ,( Case when AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode=1 then 'Approved' when AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode=5 then 'Inprocess' else '' end ) as Status ,( SELECT ISNULL(SUM(GL_TransactionDetail.Amount), 0) FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID WHERE GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID in ( SELECT Distinct DefaultAccountCode FROM SET_DocumentType WHERE DocumentType Like '%Advance Against PO%' AND CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.periodid ) AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' ) as AdvanceAmount FROM AR_InvoiceHeader LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader AR_INVH on from AR_InvoiceDetail where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1), 0)+ ,ap_purchaseOrderHeader.documentNumber as PurchaseOrderNumber --,Adv_Cheaq.Amount as AdvnceAmount ,( SELECT ISNULL(SUM(GL_TransactionDetail.Amount), 0) FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID in ( SELECT Distinct DefaultAccountCode FROM SET_DocumentType WHERE DocumentType Like '%Advance Against PO%' AND CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.periodid ) AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' ) as AdvnceAmount --New ,Isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherAmount,0) as OtherTax ,ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount,0) as OtherAmount ,( SELECT ISNULL(SUM(GL_TransactionDetail.Amount), 0) FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID in ( SELECT Distinct DefaultAccountCode FROM SET_DocumentType WHERE DocumentType Like '%Advance Against PO%' AND CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.periodid ) AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' ) as AdvanceAmount
-- New ENd
,Pay_Cheaq.InstrumentDate ,Adv_Cheaq.InstrumentNo as AdvaceCheaqNO ,isnull(AP_PaymentHeader.status,0) as IsPaymentCompleted -- Payments ,( select isnull(sum(ap_paymentinvoicesDetail.Amount),0) from ap_paymentinvoicesDetail where ap_paymentinvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and ap_paymentinvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and ap_paymentinvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and ap_paymentinvoicesDetail.status = 1 ) --- --isnull(( -- select isnull(sum(ap_paymentSupplierDetail.Amount),0) -- from ap_paymentSupplierDetail where ap_paymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID -- and ap_paymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID -- and ap_paymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID -- and ap_paymentSupplierDetail.status = 1 -- and ap_paymentSupplierDetail.Narration = 'GST' -- ),0) as PaymentAmount ,Pay_Cheaq.InstrumentNo as Pay_CheaqNO ,( Case when AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode=1 then 'Approved' when AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode=5 then 'Inprocess' else '' end ) as Status ,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo as PaymentNo FROM AR_InvoiceHeader Left join gl_transactionHEader on gl_transactionHEader.documentNo = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber and gl_transactionHEader.documenttypeid = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and gl_transactionHEader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and gl_transactionHEader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
INNER JOIN SET_Currency ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID = SET_Currency.CurrencyID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail on AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN SET_Term ON AR_InvoiceHeader.TermsID = SET_Term.TermID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID LEFT Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = AR_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID and -- Advance PO left join AP_PaymentHeader ADV_Pay on ADV_Pay.POHEaderID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID and ADV_Pay.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and ADV_Pay.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID and ADV_Pay.reversaldate is null and ADV_Pay.reversalComments is null left join ap_paymentBanksDetail Adv_Cheaq on Adv_Cheaq.PaymentHeaderID = ADV_Pay.PaymentID and Adv_Cheaq.companyID = ADV_Pay.companyID and Adv_Cheaq.periodID = ADV_Pay.periodID -------------------------------

WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 and (AR_SET_Customer.CustomerId = @VendorFilter or @VendorFilter is null) and AR_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed is null and AR_InvoiceHeader.reversalID is null AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID IS NULL) and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%DI-%'
{1}

------------ Di - Invoices SELECT Distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, SET_Currency.CurrencyName, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,
ISNULL(AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount, 0) - ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.TaxAmount, 0) - ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.DiscountAmountTaken, 0) AS NetAmount,
isnull(AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount, 0) as InvoiceAmount, SET_Term.Description AS PaymentTerms, null as PurchaseOrderDate , '' as PurchaseOrderNumber ,ADV_Pay.Amount as AdvnceAmount
--new , Isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherAmount,0) as OtherTax ,ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount,0) as OtherAmount ,( SELECT ISNULL(SUM(GL_TransactionDetail.Amount), 0) FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID WHERE GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID in ( SELECT Distinct DefaultAccountCode FROM SET_DocumentType WHERE DocumentType Like '%Advance Against PO%' AND CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.periodid ) AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' ) as AdvanceAmount -- new ENd
,Adv_Cheaq.InstrumentDate ,Adv_Cheaq.InstrumentNo as AdvaceCheaqNO
,isnull(AP_PaymentHeader.status,0) as IsPaymentCompleted
--,0 as PaymentAmount ,AP_PaymentHeader.amount + - isnull(( select isnull(sum(ap_paymentSupplierDetail.Amount),0) from ap_paymentSupplierDetail where ap_paymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and ap_paymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and ap_paymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and ap_paymentSupplierDetail.status = 1 and ap_paymentSupplierDetail.Narration = 'GST' ),0) as PaymentAmount ,'' as Pay_CheaqNO ,( Case when AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode=1 then 'Approved' when AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode=5 then 'Inprocess' else '' end ) as Status ,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo as PaymentNo FROM AR_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SET_Currency ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID = SET_Currency.CurrencyID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID LEFT JOIN AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail on AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN SET_Term ON AR_InvoiceHeader.TermsID = SET_Term.TermID
inner JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Narration != 'GST'
inner JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
LEFT Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = AR_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID left join ap_paymentinvoicesDetail on ap_paymentinvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and ap_paymentinvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and ap_paymentinvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and ap_paymentinvoicesDetail.status = 1
LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentHeader On AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = ap_paymentinvoicesDetail.CompanyID And AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = ap_paymentinvoicesDetail.PeriodID and ap_paymentinvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentHeader.status = 1
-- Advance PO left join AP_PaymentHeader ADV_Pay on ADV_Pay.POHEaderID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID and ADV_Pay.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and ADV_Pay.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID and ADV_Pay.reversaldate is null and ADV_Pay.reversalComments is null left join ap_paymentBanksDetail Adv_Cheaq on Adv_Cheaq.PaymentHeaderID = ADV_Pay.PaymentID and Adv_Cheaq.companyID = ADV_Pay.companyID and Adv_Cheaq.periodID = ADV_Pay.periodID -------------------------------

data.value: SELECT DISTINCT AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID, AR_InvoiceHeader.Status, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceReceivedDate, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS VendorName, AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode, SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus, SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator, SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID AS UserID, SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID ,AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid FROM AR_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON (INV_Item.ItemID = AR_InvoiceDetail.ItemID OR SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Direct Invoice') --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID Left JOIN AR_SET_Customer on AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = (SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND DocumentNo = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT ih.AmountPaid FROM AR_InvoiceHeader ih WHERE ih.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND ih.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND ih.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT ih.AmountPaid FROM AR_InvoiceHeader ih WHERE ih.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND ih.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND ih.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1 left join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = AR_InvoiceDetail.stockHeaderID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID

SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID desc) AS 'Row' FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceID, InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID, InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID, InvHeader_Outer.Status, InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceType, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceNumber, InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceDate, InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceReceivedDate, InvHeader_Outer.VendorID, InvHeader_Outer.StatusCode, SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus, SET_DocumentApprove.CreatedByValue as AuthorizedBy, Set_documentPendingApprove.ApprovalOperator, Set_documentPendingApprove.ApprovalUserID AS UserID ,Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName,InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID ,InvHeader_Outer.GrossAmount, InvHeader_Outer.CreatedByValue, --(Case when InvHeader_Outer.VendorID is null then ( -- case when C.CustomerName is null then ( -- Select max (AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName) from [AR_InvoiceHeader] sal_hdr -- inner join AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID= sal_hdr.InvoiceID -- and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID= sal_hdr.CompanyID -- And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID= sal_hdr.PeriodID -- And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status=1 -- and sal_hdr.InvoiceID = InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceID -- inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID=AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID -- and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID -- ) else C.CustomerName end) else AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName end) AS VendorName, case when C.CustomerName is null then ( Select TOP 1 (AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName) from [AR_InvoiceHeader] sal_hdr inner join AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID= sal_hdr.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID= sal_hdr.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID= sal_hdr.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status=1 and sal_hdr.InvoiceID = InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceID and sal_hdr.CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID=AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID ) else C.CustomerName end AS VendorName, InvHeader_Outer.AmountPaid FROM AR_InvoiceHeader InvHeader_Outer INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceType Left JOIN AR_SET_Customer on InvHeader_Outer.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceNumber AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = ( SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND PeriodID = InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceType AND DocumentNo = InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceNumber AND FiscalID = InvHeader_Outer.FiscalID ) inner join Set_documentPendingApprove on Set_documentPendingApprove.DocumentApproveID = SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentApproveID and Set_documentPendingApprove.companyID = SET_DocumentApprove.companyID and Set_documentPendingApprove.PeriodID = SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceType OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT ih.AmountPaid FROM AR_InvoiceHeader ih WHERE ih.CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND ih.PeriodID = InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND ih.InvoiceID = InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT ih.AmountPaid FROM AR_InvoiceHeader ih WHERE ih.CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND ih.PeriodID = InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND ih.InvoiceID = InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
LEFT join UsersInRoles on UsersInRoles.RoleId = SET_UserApprovalAmount.RoleId and UsersInRoles.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer C on InvHeader_Outer.VendorID = C.CustomerID --and ARINVH.CompanyID = C.CompanyID and InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID = C.PeriodID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status=1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
left join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID = InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID
left join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = AR_InvoiceDetail.stockHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID ) AR_InvoiceHeader

data.name: Query_StockHeaderDetail_ByKey
data.value:
select * from ( select case tab.IsReversed when 0 then tab.QuantityInvoiced2 - tab.InvoiceDtlQuantity else tab.QuantityInvoiced2 end as QuantityInvoiced, * from ( SELECT distinct INV_StockTransactionDetail.Comments, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID, NULL AS InvoiceDetailID, NULL AS InvoiceHeaderID, SET_DocumentType.DefaultAccountCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID as ItemUnitOfMeasureID, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, NULL AS AssetsAdditionFlag, INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit AS BaseAmount, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SupplierDCQuantity, ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - CONVERT(DECIMAL(18, 2), ISNULL( ( select isnull(SUM(TransactionQuantity), 0) from Gate_OutwardDetail where SourceHeaderID = @StockTransactionID and SourceLineID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.periodID ), 0)) AS QuantityInvoiced2, sum(isnull(convert(int, AR_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed), 0)) as IsReversed, IsNull(Sum(AR_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced), 0) as InvoiceDtlQuantity,
(((ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) - ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.LandedCost, 0)) / ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity))
- ( (((ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) - ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.LandedCost, 0)) / ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) * (isnull((select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1 ),1)) /100) AS UnitPrice, ((INV_StockTransactionDetail.SupplierDCQuantity - ( select isnull(SUM(TransactionQuantity), 0) from Gate_OutwardDetail where SourceHeaderID = 41568 and SourceLineID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.periodID )) * (INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost- ((((ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) - ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.LandedCost, 0)) / ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) * (isnull((select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1 ),1)) /100)) ) as SupplierGrossAmount,
ABS( (((ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - (Case When AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null And Isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 then IsNull(Sum(AR_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced), 0) Else 0 End ) ) *
(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost - ((((ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) - ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.LandedCost, 0)) / ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) * (isnull((select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountPer from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.status = 1 ),1)) /100))
) - ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.LandedCost, 0) ) - ( select isnull(SUM(TransactionQuantity), 0) from Gate_OutwardDetail where SourceHeaderID = 41568 and SourceLineID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.periodID ) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) AS GrossAmount, NULL AS AmountIncludesTaxFlag
, --(Select --ISNULL(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountAmount,0) -- from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and -- AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PoHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID --and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID --and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID=@PeriodID ) 0 AS DiscountAmountTaken,
( Select ISNULL(AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.DiscountBeforeGST,0) from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PoHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID=@PeriodID ) as DiscountBeforeGST,
'0' AS NetAmount, isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID, 0) as TransactionDetailID, isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID, 0) as StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, ISNULL(ISNULL(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) * (INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity - IsNull(Sum(AR_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced), 0)), 0) AS TotalAmount, '' AS Action, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SerialNo AS SerialNumber, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID , isnull((Select
case when taxAmount is not null then (select max(AR_SET_Tax.TaxRate) from AR_SET_Tax where AR_SET_Tax.TaxID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.TaxID) else 0 end
from dbo.AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PoHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID=@PeriodID ),0) AS TaxAmount, isnull((Select max(TaxID) from dbo.AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PoHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID ),0) AS TaxID, isnull((Select
case when OtherTaxAmount is not null then (select max(AR_SET_Tax.TaxRate) from AR_SET_Tax where AR_SET_Tax.TaxID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.OtherTaxID) else 0 end
from dbo.AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PoHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID=@PeriodID ),0) AS OtherTaxAmount, isnull((Select max(OtherTaxID) from dbo.AP_PurchaseOrderDetail where PODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PoHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID ),0) AS OtherTaxID,
SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryID ,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,SET_Department.DepartmentID,SET_Department.DepartmentName FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID --INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_Item.CompanyID left join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail On AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID And AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID And AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 left join AR_InvoiceHeader on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID left join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = isnull(INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID) left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID And SET_Department.Status=1 WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = @StockTransactionID AND (INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransferTransactionLookup <> @TransferType OR INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransferTransactionLookup IS NULL) AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity <> 0 Group By INV_StockTransactionDetail.Comments, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SupplierDCQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost, INV_StockTransactionDetail.LandedCost, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SerialNo, SET_DocumentType.DefaultAccountCode, INV_Item.Description, Convert(int,Description) from SET_Bucket where OFDays between FromNoOfDays and ToNoOfDays) as DaysDesc from ( select CustomerID,BusinessPartnerName as CustomerName,0 as LotNo,0 as InvoiceNumber,null as InvoiceDate, 0 as InvoiceAmount,0 as Amount , 0 as OFDays,0 as Balance,sum(Amount) as Opening ,0 ReceivedAmount from ( ---------- Payment ---------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, InstrumentNo, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, '') + (Case When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID AND childPayment.Status= 1 ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And payment.Status= 1
), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.status = 1 ) end as InvoiceNumbers, ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT ', ' + AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentDetail WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID And AP_PaymentDetail.Status= 1 ORDER BY AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND payment1.Status= 1 ), '') as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount ,AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 --AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER Join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate And SET_DocumentType.Status= 1 and join set_documentType on set_documentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and set_documentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and
