union all
select CustomerID,BusinessPartnerName as CustomerName,LotNo,DocumentNo as InvoiceNumber,DocumentDate as InvoiceDate,Amount as InvoiceAmount,0 as Amount , DateDiff(day , DocumentDate,convert(date,@ToDate) ) as OFDays,0 as Balance,0 as Opening ,0 as ReceivedAmount from (
select distinct TABInvoice.DocumentType, TABInvoice.CreateDate, TABInvoice.CustomerID, TABInvoice.BusinessPartnerName, TABInvoice.SourceID, TABInvoice.Amount, TABInvoice.InstrumentNo, TABInvoice.Comments, TABInvoice.InvoiceNumbers, TABInvoice.InvoiceDocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentDate, TABInvoice.FreightAmount, TABInvoice.ForAlhajAmount , TABInvoice.StatusCode,0 as Lotno from ( ---------- Vendor Invoice ---------- SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.companyID, Set_DocumentType.TransactionType, case when AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode is null then ( select top 1 CUS.TypeCode from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.BusinessPartnerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = CUS.TypeCode And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status= 1
) else AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode end as TypeCode, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status= 1 And CUS.Status= 1 ) else ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceHeader.Status= 1 And CUS.Status= 1 ) end as CustomerID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status= 1 And CUS.Status= 1 ) else ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceHeader.Status= 1 And CUS.status= 1 ) end as BusinessPartnerName, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceSupplierID as SourceID,
case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then (Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount else AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount end) else ( Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Debit Note' then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid else (AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid+AR_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount - isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherAmount,0)) end ) end as Amount,
'0' AS InstrumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.Description AS Comments, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount ,AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ASCUS ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = ASCUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = ASCUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = ASCUS.PeriodID AND ASCUS.Status = 1 left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.vENDORid AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate And SET_DocumentType.status= 1
) TABInvoice where TABInvoice.companyID = @companyId {1}
)as InvoiceTab
)as FinTab inner join Ar_Set_Customer on Ar_Set_Customer.CustomerID = FinTab.CustomerID left join SET_Term on SET_Term.TermID = Ar_Set_Customer.StandardTermID where FinTab.CustomerID in (select BusinessPartnerID from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes where typeCode = 1) order by FinTab.CustomerID,FinTab.InvoiceDate Asc

data.name: Query_VendorAgingWithBucket
data.value:
select FinTab.CustomerID,FinTab.CustomerName,LotNo,InvoiceNumber,InvoiceDate, InvoiceAmount,Amount , OFDays,Balance,Opening ,ReceivedAmount,isnull(SET_Term.Description,'') as Term ,SET_Bucket.Description,SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays
from ( select CustomerID,BusinessPartnerName as CustomerName,0 as LotNo,0 as InvoiceNumber,convert(date,'2000-01-01') as InvoiceDate, 0 as InvoiceAmount,0 as Amount , 0 as OFDays,0 as Balance,sum(Amount) as Opening ,0 ReceivedAmount from ( ---------- Payment ---------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID as SourceID, (Case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount else AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end) as Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo AS InstrumentNo, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, '') + (Case When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID AND childPayment.Status= 1 ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And payment.Status= 1
), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.status = 1 ) end as InvoiceNumbers, ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT ', ' + AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentDetail WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID And AP_PaymentDetail.Status= 1 ORDER BY AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND payment1.Status= 1 ), '') as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount ,AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 --AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER Join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate And SET_DocumentType.Status= 1 {0}
GROUP BY AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments ,AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode
union all --RECEIPT TRANSACTION SELECT distinct SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID as SourceID, case when (select DocumentType from Set_documentTYpe where Set_documentTYpe.Status= 1 And Set_documentTYpe.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID) like 'Receipt Against Sale%' then (select sum(Amount) from AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail where AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.status = 1 And ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID) *-1 else AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount * -1 end as Amount, max(AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.InstrumentNo) AS InstrumentNo, IsNull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Comments, '') + (Case When AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 left join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail on AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.status=1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 {0} INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID = AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID Left Join AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail on AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate And SET_DocumentType.Status= 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID not in ( select ReceiptHeaderID from AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail inner join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader RecHDR on RecHDR.ReceiptTransactionID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and RecHDR.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and RecHDR.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and RecHDR.Status = 1 inner join set_documentType on set_documentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and set_documentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and set_documentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And set_documentType.Status= 1 INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID where AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and set_documentType.documentType not like 'Carriage Contractor Adjustment' and set_documentType.documentType not like 'Receipt Against Sale Invoices' and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1 )
GROUP BY AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID, AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID, AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptAccountID,AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.Amount, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Comments, ReversalComments ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID
UNION ALL -- Receipt Transaction Without Opening SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID as SourceID, Case when AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount else AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount * -1 end as Amount, max(AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.InstrumentNo) AS InstrumentNo, IsNull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Comments, '') + (Case When AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Narration Else ' ' + AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 left join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail on AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.status=1 INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 {0} INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode LEFT Join AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail on AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.Status= 1 INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%opening%' AND SET_DocumentType.status= 1
GROUP BY AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Comments, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode ,AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Narration
union all
---------- Payment ----------
SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID as SourceID,
(Case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount else AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end) as Amount,
AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo AS InstrumentNo, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, '') + (Case When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID AND childPayment.Status= 1 ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And payment.Status= 1
), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.status = 1 ) end as InvoiceNumbers, ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT ', ' + AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentDetail WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID And AP_PaymentDetail.Status= 1 ORDER BY AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND payment1.Status= 1 ), '') as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount ,AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 --AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER Join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate And SET_DocumentType.Status= 1 {0}
GROUP BY AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments ,AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode
union all
-- PAYMENT -- SINGLE BUSINESS PARTNER CASE SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID as SourceID, (Case when AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType is not null then AP_PaymentHeader.Amount * -1 else AP_PaymentHeader.Amount end) as Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo AS InstrumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments + (Case When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID And childPayment.Status= 1 ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 0, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And payment.Status= 1 ), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.status= 1 And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumbers, ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT ', ' + AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentDetail WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID And AP_PaymentDetail.Status= 1 ORDER BY AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And payment1.Status= 1 ), '') as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount , AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode
FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate And SET_DocumentType.Status= 1
{0}
GROUP BY AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType, AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID,AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID,AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments ,AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode
)as Tab group by CustomerID,BusinessPartnerName
union all
select CustomerID,BusinessPartnerName as CustomerName,LotNo,DocumentNo as InvoiceNumber,DocumentDate as InvoiceDate,Amount as InvoiceAmount,0 as Amount , DateDiff(day , DocumentDate,convert(date,@ToDate) ) as OFDays,0 as Balance,0 as Opening ,0 as ReceivedAmount from (
select distinct TABInvoice.DocumentType, TABInvoice.CreateDate, TABInvoice.CustomerID, TABInvoice.BusinessPartnerName, TABInvoice.SourceID, TABInvoice.Amount, TABInvoice.InstrumentNo, TABInvoice.Comments, TABInvoice.InvoiceNumbers, TABInvoice.InvoiceDocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentDate, TABInvoice.FreightAmount, TABInvoice.ForAlhajAmount , TABInvoice.StatusCode,0 as Lotno from ( ---------- Vendor Invoice ---------- SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.companyID, Set_DocumentType.TransactionType, case when AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode is null then ( select top 1 CUS.TypeCode from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.BusinessPartnerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = CUS.TypeCode And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status= 1
) else AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode end as TypeCode, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status= 1 And CUS.Status= 1 ) else ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceHeader.Status= 1 And CUS.Status= 1 ) end as CustomerID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status= 1 And CUS.Status= 1 ) else ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceHeader.Status= 1 And CUS.status= 1 ) end as BusinessPartnerName, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceSupplierID as SourceID,
case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then (Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount else AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount end) else ( Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Debit Note' then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid else (AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid+AR_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount - isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherAmount,0)) end ) end as Amount,
'0' AS InstrumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.Description AS Comments, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount ,AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ASCUS ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = ASCUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = ASCUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = ASCUS.PeriodID AND ASCUS.Status = 1 left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.vENDORid AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate And SET_DocumentType.status= 1
) TABInvoice where TABInvoice.companyID = @companyId {1}
)as InvoiceTab
)as FinTab inner join Ar_Set_Customer on Ar_Set_Customer.CustomerID = FinTab.CustomerID left join SET_Term on SET_Term.TermID = Ar_Set_Customer.StandardTermID INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON SET_Bucket.CompanyID = 1 and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 where FinTab.CustomerID in (select BusinessPartnerID from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes where typeCode = 1) And (DATEDIFF(day, FinTab.InvoiceDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, FinTab.InvoiceDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) order by FinTab.CustomerID,FinTab.InvoiceDate Asc

data.name: Query_VendorStatement
data.value:
select *,( Case when (DocumentType like 'Vendor%Invoice %' or DocumentType like 'DI-Invoice%') then -- 0 isnull((select max(InvoiceHeaderID) from dbo.AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail where invoiceheaderid = FinalTAB.SourceID),SourceID) when DocumentType like '%Payment%' then --0 (select max(InvoiceHeaderID) from dbo.AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail where invoiceheaderid= FinalTAB.SourceID)
end
)InvoiceGroup , (Case when (DocumentType like 'Vendor%Invoice%' or DocumentType like 'DI-Invoice%') then DocumentNo when DocumentType like 'op%' then 0 else -1 end) GroupNo
from
(
select * from ( SELECT FINTAB.DocumentType, Fintab.CreateDate, FINTAB.CustomerID, FINTAB.Name, FinTab.SourceID, SUM(FINTAB.Amount) as Amount, FINTAB.InstrumentNo, FINTAB.Comments, FINTAB.InvoiceNumbers, FINTAB.InvoiceDocumentNo, FINTAB.DocumentNo, FINTAB.DocumentDate, FINTAB.FreightAmount, FINTAB.ForAlhajAmount, FINTAB.GroupName,FINTAB.SalePerson,SUM(FINTAB.TaxAmountOnNet)TaxAmountOnNet FROM ( select distinct TABInvoice.DocumentType, TABInvoice.CreateDate, TABInvoice.CustomerID, TABInvoice.Name, TABInvoice.SourceID, TABInvoice.Amount, TABInvoice.InstrumentNo, TABInvoice.Comments, TABInvoice.InvoiceNumbers, TABInvoice.InvoiceDocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentDate, TABInvoice.FreightAmount, TABInvoice.ForAlhajAmount,TABInvoice.GroupName,TABInvoice.SalePerson,TaxAmountOnNet,InvoiceDetailID from ( ---------- Vendor Invoice ---------- SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.companyID, Set_DocumentType.TransactionType, case when AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode is null then ( select top 1 CUS.TypeCode from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.BusinessPartnerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) else AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode end as TypeCode, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) else ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) end as CustomerID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) else ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) end as Name, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID as SourceID, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then (Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount else AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount*-1 end) else ( Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Debit Note' then AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount else AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount * -1 end ) end as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.Description AS Comments, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,'' as SalePerson ,COnvert(decimal(18,2),AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmountOnNet)TaxAmountOnNet,InvoiceDetailID FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ASCUS ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = ASCUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = ASCUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = ASCUS.PeriodID AND ASCUS.Status = 1 Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.vENDORid AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
) TABInvoice where TABInvoice.companyID = @companyId
UNION ALL ---------- Payment ---------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID as SourceID, (Case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount else AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end) as Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo AS InstrumentNo, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, '') + (Case When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumbers, ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT ', ' + AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentDetail WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID ORDER BY AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ), '') as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,'' as SalePerson ,0,0 FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER Join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
Left JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID= AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID= AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.invoiceHeaderID Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
GROUP BY AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName UNION ALL
-- PAYMENT -- SINGLE BUSINESS PARTNER CASE SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID as SourceID, (Case when AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType is not null then AP_PaymentHeader.Amount * -1 else AP_PaymentHeader.Amount end) as Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo AS InstrumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments + (Case When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 0, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumbers, ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT ', ' + AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentDetail WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID ORDER BY AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ), '') as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,'' as SalePerson ,0,0 FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit'
LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
Left JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID= AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID= AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID= AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
GROUP BY AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType, AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID,AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID,AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName ,AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID
UNION ALL

), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumbers, ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT ', ' + AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentDetail WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID ORDER BY AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ), '') as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,'' as SalePerson,0 ,0 FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit'
LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
Left JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID= AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID= AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID --LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID -- AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID
LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID left join AP_PaymentHeader ADV_Pay on ADV_Pay.POHEaderID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID and ADV_Pay.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and ADV_Pay.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID and ADV_Pay.reversaldate is null and ADV_Pay.reversalComments is null left join ap_paymentBanksDetail Adv_Cheaq on Adv_Cheaq.PaymentHeaderID = ADV_Pay.PaymentID and Adv_Cheaq.companyID = ADV_Pay.companyID and Adv_Cheaq.periodID = ADV_Pay.periodID
INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
GROUP BY AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType,ADV_Pay.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID,AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID,AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName ,AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID
) AS FINTAB GROUP BY DocumentType, CreateDate, CustomerID, NAME, SourceID, InstrumentNo, Comments, InvoiceNumbers, InvoiceDocumentNo, DocumentNo, DocumentDate, FreightAmount, ForAlhajAmount,GroupName,FINTAB.SalePerson ) as TAb ---- For Transation type Filter
) as FinalTAB where FinalTAB.Amount <> 0 {0}
Order By DocumentDate,Name asc

select FinTab.CustomerID,FinTab.CustomerName,LotNo,InvoiceNumber,InvoiceDate, InvoiceAmount,Amount , ISNULL(OFDays,0) as OFDays,Balance,Opening ,ReceivedAmount,isnull(SET_Term.Description,'') as Term ,ISNULL((Select Convert(int,Description) from SET_Bucket where OFDays between FromNoOfDays and ToNoOfDays),0) as DaysDesc,AdvanceAmount,PaidAmount,TermsID,IsNull(NoofDays,0) as PaymentTerm,DATEADD(day,IsNull(NoofDays,0),InvoiceDate) as DueDate ,case when (IsNull(NoofDays,0) -ISNULL(OFDays,0) <= 0 ) then 1 else 0 end as IsDue from ( select CustomerID,BusinessPartnerName as CustomerName,0 as LotNo,0 as InvoiceNumber,null as InvoiceDate, 0 as InvoiceAmount,0 as Amount , 0 as OFDays,0 as Balance,sum(Amount) as Opening ,0 ReceivedAmount,0 as AdvanceAmount,0 as PaidAmount,0 as TermsID from ( ---------- Payment ---------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID as SourceID, (Case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount else AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end) as Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo AS InstrumentNo, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, '') + (Case When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID AND childPayment.Status= 1 ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And payment.Status= 1
), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.status = 1 ) end as InvoiceNumbers, ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT ', ' + AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentDetail WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID And AP_PaymentDetail.Status= 1 ORDER BY AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND payment1.Status= 1 ), '') as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount ,AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 --AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER Join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate And SET_DocumentType.Status= 1 {0}
GROUP BY AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments ,AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode

WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate And SET_DocumentType.Status= 1 and join set_documentType on set_documentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and set_documentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID as SourceID, (Case when AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType is not null then AP_PaymentHeader.Amount * -1 else AP_PaymentHeader.Amount end) as Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo AS InstrumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments + (Case When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID And childPayment.Status= 1 ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 0, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And payment.Status= 1 ), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.status= 1 And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumbers, ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT ', ' + AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentDetail WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID And AP_PaymentDetail.Status= 1 ORDER BY AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And payment1.Status= 1 ), '') as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount , AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode
FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate And SET_DocumentType.Status= 1
{0}
GROUP BY AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType, AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID,AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID,AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments ,AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode
)as Tab group by CustomerID,BusinessPartnerName
union all
select CustomerID,BusinessPartnerName as CustomerName,LotNo,DocumentNo as InvoiceNumber,Max(DocumentDate) as InvoiceDate,SUM(Amount) as InvoiceAmount,0 as Amount , DateDiff(day , DocumentDate,convert(date,@ToDate) ) as OFDays,0 as Balance,0 as Opening ,0 as ReceivedAmount,SUm(AdvanceAmount),SUm(PaidAmount),TermsID from (
select distinct TABInvoice.DocumentType, TABInvoice.CreateDate, TABInvoice.CustomerID, TABInvoice.BusinessPartnerName, TABInvoice.SourceID, TABInvoice.Amount, TABInvoice.InstrumentNo, TABInvoice.Comments, TABInvoice.InvoiceNumbers, TABInvoice.InvoiceDocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentDate, TABInvoice.FreightAmount, TABInvoice.ForAlhajAmount , TABInvoice.StatusCode,0 as Lotno,AdvanceAmount,PaidAmount,TermsID from ( ---------- Vendor Invoice ---------- SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.companyID,AR_InvoiceHeader.TermsID, Set_DocumentType.TransactionType, case when AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode is null then ( select top 1 CUS.TypeCode from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.BusinessPartnerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = CUS.TypeCode And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status= 1
) else AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode end as TypeCode, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status= 1 And CUS.Status= 1 ) else ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceHeader.Status= 1 And CUS.Status= 1 ) end as CustomerID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status= 1 And CUS.Status= 1 ) else ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceHeader.Status= 1 And CUS.status= 1 ) end as BusinessPartnerName, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceSupplierID as SourceID,
case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then (Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount else AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount end) else ( Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Debit Note' then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid else (AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid+AR_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount - isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherAmount,0)) end ) end as Amount,
'0' AS InstrumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.Description AS Comments, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount ,AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode,0 as AdvanceAmount,0 as PaidAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ASCUS ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = ASCUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = ASCUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = ASCUS.PeriodID AND ASCUS.Status = 1 left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.vENDORid AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate And SET_DocumentType.status= 1
union all

distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON
