payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID And childPayment.Status= 1 ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 0, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And payment.Status= 1 ), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.status= 1 And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumbers, ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT ', ' + AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentDetail WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID And AP_PaymentDetail.Status= 1 ORDER BY AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And payment1.Status= 1 ), '') as InvoiceDocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber AS DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount , AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode, (Case when AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType is not null then AP_PaymentHeader.Amount * -1 else AP_PaymentHeader.Amount end) as AdvanceAmount, 0 as PaidAmount
FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AP_PaymentHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID
left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID
left join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID

WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate And SET_DocumentType.Status= 1 and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Advance Against PO%'

GROUP BY AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType, AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID,AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID,AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments ,AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode,SET_DocumentType.TransactionType,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.TermsID

PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber AS DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount , AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode,0 as AdvanceAmount, --(Case when AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType is not null -- then AP_PaymentHeader.Amount * -1 -- else AP_PaymentHeader.Amount -- end) as PaidAmount SUm(AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Amount) as PaidAmount

data.name: Query_TradeOtherPayable
data.value:
Select tab.Heading as Heading ,tab.CodeDescription as CodeDescription ,SUM(tab.Amount) as Amount ,SUM(tab.PreviousAmount) as PreviousAmount from ( select 'Other Payable' as Heading, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,GL_TransactionDetail.Amount as Amount ,0 as PreviousAmount from GL_TransactionDetail inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionDetail.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1
where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID and (GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @Todate) and (GL_CodeCombinationDetail .Description like '%Mess payabl%'or GL_CodeCombinationDetail .Description like '%Education cess%' or GL_CodeCombinationDetail .Description like '%Circle Office%' or GL_CodeCombinationDetail .Description like '%Misc%' or GL_CodeCombinationDetail .Description like '%Insurance claim payabl%' or GL_CodeCombinationDetail .Description like '%Electricity generation%' or GL_CodeCombinationDetail .Description like '%Vehicle running %% maintenance%' or GL_CodeCombinationDetail .Description like '%Education cell%' or GL_CodeCombinationDetail .Description like '%Officer club%' or GL_CodeCombinationDetail .Description like '%LG & singer%' ) --and convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) <= getdate()
--group by GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description,GL_TransactionDetail.Amount
UNION ALL
select 'Other Payable' as Heading, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,0 as Amount,GL_TransactionDetail.Amount as PreviousAmount
from GL_TransactionDetail inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionDetail.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1
where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID and (CAST(GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate As date) BETWEEN CAST(DATEADD(YEAR,-1,@FromDate)AS Date) AND CAST(DATEADD(YEAR,-1,@Todate) AS Date)) and (GL_CodeCombinationDetail .Description like '%Mess payabl%'or GL_CodeCombinationDetail .Description like '%Education cess%' or GL_CodeCombinationDetail .Description like '%Circle Office%' or GL_CodeCombinationDetail .Description like '%Misc%' or GL_CodeCombinationDetail .Description like '%Insurance claim payabl%' or GL_CodeCombinationDetail .Description like '%Electricity generation%' or GL_CodeCombinationDetail .Description like '%Vehicle running %% maintenance%' or GL_CodeCombinationDetail .Description like '%Education cell%' or GL_CodeCombinationDetail .Description like '%Officer club%' or GL_CodeCombinationDetail .Description like '%LG & singer%' )
--group by GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description,GL_TransactionDetail.Amount )tab group By tab.CodeDescription,tab.Heading

data.value:

(select (convert(decimal,(SUBSTRING(ap_paymentSupplierDetailinner.TaxName,0,CHARINDEX('%',ap_paymentSupplierDetailinner.TaxName,0))))) from ap_paymentSupplierDetail ap_paymentSupplierDetailinner inner join ap_paymentHeader ap_paymentHeaderinenr on ap_paymentHeaderinenr.PaymentID = ap_paymentSupplierDetailinner.PaymentHeaderID and ap_paymentHeaderinenr.CompanyID = BusinessPartnerName like '%IT With%' where ap_paymentHeaderinenr.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and ap_paymentSupplierDetailinner.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and ap_paymentSupplierDetailinner.SupplierAccountCode = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.fk_codecombinationid and ap_paymentSupplierDetailinner.invoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID) as TaxRate ,(select (ap_paymentSupplierDetailinner.Amount) from ap_paymentSupplierDetail ap_paymentSupplierDetailinner inner join ap_paymentHeader ap_paymentHeaderinenr on ap_paymentHeaderinenr.PaymentID = ap_paymentSupplierDetailinner.PaymentHeaderID and ap_paymentHeaderinenr.CompanyID = ap_paymentSupplierDetailinner.CompanyID and ap_paymentHeaderinenr.PeriodID = ap_paymentSupplierDetailinner.PeriodID and ap_paymentHeaderinenr.Status = 1 and ap_paymentSupplierDetailinner.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartner On AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and BusinessPartnerName like '%IT With%' where ap_paymentHeaderinenr.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and ap_paymentSupplierDetailinner.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and ap_paymentSupplierDetailinner.SupplierAccountCode = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.fk_codecombinationid and ap_paymentBanksDetail.status = 1 ) as ChequeNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber ,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate -- ( -- SELECT STUFF( -- ( -- SELECT distinct ',' + AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber -- FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment -- LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID -- AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID -- LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID -- AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID -- LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID -- AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID -- where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID -- --ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber -- FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE -- ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 1, '') AS InvoiceNumbers -- FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment -- where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID -- and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID -- and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
-- ) as InvoiceNumber --, -- ( -- SELECT STUFF( -- ( -- SELECT distinct ',' + FORMAT(InvoiceDate, 'dd/MM/yyyy') -- FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment -- LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID -- AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID -- LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID -- AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID -- LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID -- AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID -- where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID -- --ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber -- FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE -- ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 1, '') AS InvoiceNumbers -- FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment -- where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID -- and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID -- and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
-- ) as InvoiceDate ,AP_PaymentHeader.CPRNO from ap_paymentHeader
inner join ap_paymentSupplierDetail on ap_paymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = ap_paymentHeader.PaymentID and ap_paymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = ap_paymentHeader.CompanyID and ap_paymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = ap_paymentHeader.PeriodID and ap_paymentSupplierDetail.status = 1 inner join AR_Set_Customer on AR_Set_Customer.customerid = ap_paymentSupplierDetail.supplierID inner join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerCategoryID inner join AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail on AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = ap_paymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = ap_paymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = ap_paymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.status = 1

WHERE ap_paymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND ap_paymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND ap_paymentHeader.Status = 1 and Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = @CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID and ap_paymentHeader.DocumentDate between @fromDate and @Todate
group by Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory,AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName,AR_Set_Customer.CNICNumber,ap_paymentHeader.DocumentDate,ap_paymentHeader.PaymentID ,ap_paymentHeader.CompanyID,ap_paymentHeader.PeriodID,ap_paymentHeader.DocumentNo , AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID,AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID,AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID ,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber,ap_paymentSupplierDetail.invoiceHeaderID,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID ,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,AP_PaymentHeader.CPRNO
)t where IsNull(t.TaxDeducted,0) != 0

data.name: Query_LegalProfessionalCharges
data.value:
--Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2021-03-18 00:00:00:000'
select TableFinal.Heading, TableFinal.CustomerName, SUM(TableFinal.OpeningAmount) as OpeningAmount , SUM(TableFinal.Expense) as Expense, SUM(TableFinal.Paid) as Paid, SUM(TableFinal.Closing) as Closing ,TableFinal.invoiceYear
from (
select Final.Heading , Final.CustomerName, (SUM(Final.Expense) - SUM(Final.Paid)) as OpeningAmount ,0 as Paid, 0 as Expense, 0 as Closing , Final.invoiceYear
from (
select distinct 'Legal Charges' as Heading, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,0 as OpeningAmount,AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount as Expense ,0 as Paid,0 as Closing
--,year(AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate) as invoiceYear , (select top 1 periodsetname from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @ToDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc) as invoiceYear from AR_InvoiceHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
Inner join AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail on AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Status = 1
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.​CodeCombinationID = AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1
inner join SET_AccountType ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.[AccountTypeID] = SET_AccountType.[AccountTypeID]​​ and SET_AccountType.Status = 1
where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID --and AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'DI-%' and SET_AccountType.AccountTypeName like '%Expenses%' and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID in (select CodeCombinationID from GL_CodeCombinationDetail where Description like '%LEGAL%') and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < ( select top 1 StartDate from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @ToDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc )
UNION ALL
select distinct 'Legal Charges' as Heading, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,0 as OpeningAmount ,0 as Expense ,(case when AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount else 0 end) as Paid ,0 as Closing
--,year(AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate) as invoiceYear , (select top 1 periodsetname from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @ToDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc) as invoiceYear
from AP_PaymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
Inner join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
--inner join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID --and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID --and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID --and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Status = 1
--inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.​CodeCombinationID = AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID --and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1
--inner join SET_AccountType ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.[AccountTypeID] = SET_AccountType.[AccountTypeID]​​ --and SET_AccountType.Status = 1
where AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID --and AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'Payment Against Direct Invoices%' and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < ( select top 1 StartDate from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @ToDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc )
)Final Group by Final.Heading, Final.CustomerName, invoiceYear
UNION ALL
select Final.Heading , Final.CustomerName, 0 as OpeningAmount ,SUM(Final.Paid) as Paid, SUM(Final.Expense) as Expense, (SUM(Final.Expense) - SUM(Final.Paid)) as Closing , Final.invoiceYear
from (
select distinct 'Legal Charges' as Heading, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,0 as OpeningAmount,AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount as Expense ,0 as Paid,0 as Closing
--,year(AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate) as invoiceYear , (select top 1 periodsetname from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @ToDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc) as invoiceYear from AR_InvoiceHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
Inner join AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail on AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Status = 1
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.​CodeCombinationID = AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1
inner join SET_AccountType ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.[AccountTypeID] = SET_AccountType.[AccountTypeID]​​ and SET_AccountType.Status = 1
where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID --and AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'DI-%' and SET_AccountType.AccountTypeName like '%Expenses%' and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID in (select CodeCombinationID from GL_CodeCombinationDetail where Description like '%LEGAL%') and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between ( select top 1 StartDate from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @ToDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc ) and @ToDate
UNION ALL
select distinct 'Legal Charges' as Heading, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,0 as OpeningAmount ,0 as Expense ,(case when AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount else 0 end) as Paid ,0 as Closing
--,year(AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate) as invoiceYear , (select top 1 periodsetname from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @ToDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc) as invoiceYear
from AP_PaymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
Inner join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
--inner join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID --and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID --and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID --and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Status = 1
--inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.​CodeCombinationID = AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID --and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1
--inner join SET_AccountType ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.[AccountTypeID] = SET_AccountType.[AccountTypeID]​​ --and SET_AccountType.Status = 1
where AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID --and AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'Payment Against Direct Invoices%' and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between ( select top 1 StartDate from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @ToDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc ) and @ToDate
)Final Group by Final.Heading, Final.CustomerName, invoiceYear
)TableFinal inner join AR_Set_Customer on AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName = TableFinal.CustomerName where AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 {0} Group by TableFinal.Heading, TableFinal.CustomerName, TableFinal.invoiceYear
UNION ALL
select TableFinal.Heading, TableFinal.CustomerName, SUM(TableFinal.OpeningAmount) as OpeningAmount , SUM(TableFinal.Expense) as Expense, SUM(TableFinal.Paid) as Paid, SUM(TableFinal.Closing) as Closing ,TableFinal.invoiceYear
from (
select Final.Heading , Final.CustomerName, (SUM(Final.Expense) - SUM(Final.Paid)) as OpeningAmount ,0 as Paid, 0 as Expense, 0 as Closing , Final.invoiceYear
from (
select distinct 'Professional Charges' as Heading, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,0 as OpeningAmount,AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount as Expense ,0 as Paid,0 as Closing
--,year(AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate) as invoiceYear , (select top 1 periodsetname from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @ToDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc) as invoiceYear from AR_InvoiceHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
Inner join AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail on AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Status = 1
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.​CodeCombinationID = AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1
inner join SET_AccountType ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.[AccountTypeID] = SET_AccountType.[AccountTypeID]​​ and SET_AccountType.Status = 1

where AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID --and AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'Payment Against Direct Invoices%' and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < ( select top 1 StartDate from Set_PeriodCustom where Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = @PeriodID and @ToDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 order by Set_PeriodCustom.periodsetname desc )

from AP_PaymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1

inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1

--Declare @FromDate datetime = '2019-10-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2020-04-30 00:00:00:000' --Declare @CustomerID int = null --Declare @CompanyID int = 1 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1
select ROW_NUMBER() Over(Order by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName asc) as SrNo ,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentNo,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.RecievingDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,isnull(AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.FEDAmount,0) as SalesTax ,isnull(AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.FurtherTax,0) as FurtherTax ,isnull(AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.WithHoldingTax,0) as WithHoldingTax ,isnull(AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.AdvanceAmount,0) as ValueInclusiveSTax ,(isnull(AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.AdvanceAmount,0) - isnull(AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.FEDAmount,0) - isnull(AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.FurtherTax,0)) as ValueExclusiveSTax ,AP_AdvanceSugarpayment.Quantity ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate ,isnull(SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceTaxAmount,0) as SalesTaxAdjusted ,isnull(SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.FurtherTaxAdvance,0) as FurtherTaxAdjusted ,isnull(SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.WHAdvance,0) as WithHoldingTaxAdjusted ,isnull(SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceQty,0) as DetailQuantity ,SET_City.CityName
,convert(varchar(Max),(Select SUBSTRING( ( SELECT ',' + Convert(Varchar(Max),Invoice.SONumber) AS 'data()' from ( select SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo as SONumber
from SAL_InvoiceDetail LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN SAL_DispatchHeader ON SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[FiscalID] AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1
Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1
Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractDetail On SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left Join SAL_ContractHeader ON SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID AND SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_ContractHeader.Status = 1
where SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
)Invoice group by SONumber FOR XML PATH('') ), 2 , 9999) ) )As SONumber
,convert(varchar(Max),(Select SUBSTRING( ( SELECT ',' + Convert(Varchar(Max),Invoice.DONumber) AS 'data()' from ( select SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo as DONumber
from SAL_InvoiceDetail LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN SAL_DispatchHeader ON SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[FiscalID] AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1
Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1
Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractDetail On SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left Join SAL_ContractHeader ON SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID AND SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_ContractHeader.Status = 1
where SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
)Invoice group by DONumber FOR XML PATH('') ), 2 , 9999) ) )As DONumber
from SAL_InvoiceHeader inner join SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment on SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1
inner join AP_AdvanceSugarPayment on AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PaymentID = SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.AdvancePaymentID and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
left join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID and SET_City.Status = 1
where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceTaxAmount > 0 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND (SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = @CustomerID OR @CustomerID IS NULL) and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType in @DocumentTypeID {0} order by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName asc

where AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID ),0) as CPRNO
from AR_InvoiceHeader inner join AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID
left join SET_TaxCardType on SET_TaxCardType.TaxCardTypeID = AR_SET_Customer.TaxCardTypeID
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and (AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName like 'Transporter' OR AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName like 'Service_Providers') -- Service Providers And Transporter
Left Join Set_WHTaxStatement_Par on Set_WHTaxStatement_Par.WHTaxID= AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.WHTaxID Left Join Set_WHTaxStatementExemption_Par on Set_WHTaxStatementExemption_Par.WHTaxExemptionID= AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.WHTaxExemptionID
where AR_SET_Customer.TaxationStatusID <> -1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate {0} )t

data.name: Query_ExpansesOfSugar
data.value:
select Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory,Name,Sum(Amount) as Amount,Year(DocumentDate) as Year from(
select DocumentType,FinalTAB.CreateDate,FinalTAB.CompanyID ,FinalTAB.CustomerID ,case when HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode is null then UPPER(Name) else UPPER(Name) + ' (' + HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode + ')' end as Name ,SourceID ,Amount ,UPPER(InstrumentNo) as InstrumentNo ,Upper(Comments) as Comments , UPPER(DetailNarration)as DetailNarration ,InvoiceNumbers ,InvoiceDocumentNo ,DocumentNo ,DocumentDate ,FreightAmount ,ForAlhajAmount ,upper(BPType) as BPType ,GRN_NO,PO_NO,(select OperatingUnitName from SET_OperatingUnit where OperatingUnitId = FinalTAB.CompanyID) as UnitName from ( select 'Opening' AS DocumentType, @FromDate AS CreateDate,CompanyID, TABopening.CustomerID, TABopening.Name, -1 AS SourceID, SUM(TABopening.Amount) as Amount, '' AS InstrumentNo, '' as Comments, '' as DetailNarration, '' AS InvoiceNumbers, '' AS InvoiceDocumentNo, '' AS DocumentNo, @FromDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 AS ForAlhajAmount ,'' as BPType,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO from ( SELECT FINTAB.DocumentType, Fintab.CreateDate,Fintab.CompanyID, FINTAB.CustomerID, FINTAB.Name, FinTab.SourceID, SUM(FINTAB.Amount) as Amount, FINTAB.InstrumentNo, FINTAB.Comments, FINTAB.InvoiceNumbers, FINTAB.InvoiceDocumentNo, FINTAB.DocumentNo, FINTAB.DocumentDate, FINTAB.FreightAmount, FINTAB.ForAlhajAmount FROM ( Select 'Opening' as DocumentType, @FromDate AS CreateDate,0 as CompanyID, openingTAB.CustomerID, openingTAB.Name, -1 AS SourceID, sum(openingTAB.Amount) as Amount, '' as InstrumentNo, '' as Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, '' as DocumentNo, @FromDate as DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount From ( ---------- OPENING BALANCE VENDOR INVOICE ---------- SELECT 0 as Amount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS Name, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID as SourceID FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode LEFT Join AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail on AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID
WHERE AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate And (SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID =@DocumentTypeiD Or @DocumentTypeiD is Null)
GROUP BY AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID ) OpeningTAB GROUP BY OpeningTAB.CustomerID ,OpeningTAB.Name
UNION ALL
select distinct TABInvoice.DocumentType, TABInvoice.CreateDate,CompanyID, TABInvoice.CustomerID, TABInvoice.BusinessPartnerName, TABInvoice.SourceID, TABInvoice.Amount, TABInvoice.InstrumentNo, TABInvoice.Comments, TABInvoice.InvoiceNumbers, TABInvoice.InvoiceDocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentDate, TABInvoice.FreightAmount, TABInvoice.ForAlhajAmount from ( ---------- Vendor Invoice ---------- SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.companyID, Set_DocumentType.TransactionType, case when AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode is null then ( select top 1 CUS.TypeCode from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.BusinessPartnerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) else AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode end as TypeCode, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) else ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) end as CustomerID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) else ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) end as BusinessPartnerName, -- AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceSupplierID as SourceID, CASE WHEN AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceSupplierID else AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID end as SourceID, --case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then -- (Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount else AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end) -- else -- ( -- Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid -- when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Debit Note' then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid -- else (Isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid,0) + Isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount,0) - ISnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherAmount,0)) * -1 end -- ) end as Amount, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then (Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount else AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end) else ( Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' AND AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Debit Note' then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid --else (AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid + AR_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount - isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherAmount,0)) * -1 end else ( select sum(invdtl.GrossAmount) from AR_InvoiceDetail invdtl where invdtl.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and invdtl.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and invdtl.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and invdtl.Status = 1
) * -1 end
) end as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, case when AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber is not null then Concat(AR_InvoiceHeader.Description ,'PO# ', ((Select top 1 AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader left join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1 Where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 )), 'GRN#', (Select top 1 DocumentNo from INV_StockTransactionHeader left Join AR_InvoiceDetail on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID=AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1 Where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 ) ) else AR_InvoiceHeader.Description end As Comments, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ASCUS ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = ASCUS.CustomerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = ASCUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = ASCUS.PeriodID AND ASCUS.Status = 1 left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.vENDORid AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_InvoiceHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
left join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID=AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1
--left Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID=AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1
WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate And (SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID =@DocumentTypeiD Or @DocumentTypeiD is Null)
--and SET_DocumentType.documenttype not like '%Opening%' ) TABInvoice where TABInvoice.companyID in (@CompanyID)
union all ---------- Vendor Invoice supplier ---------- select distinct TABInvoice.DocumentType, TABInvoice.CreateDate,CompanyID, TABInvoice.CustomerID, TABInvoice.BusinessPartnerName, TABInvoice.SourceID, TABInvoice.Amount, TABInvoice.InstrumentNo, TABInvoice.Comments, TABInvoice.InvoiceNumbers, TABInvoice.InvoiceDocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentDate, TABInvoice.FreightAmount, TABInvoice.ForAlhajAmount from ( ---------- Vendor Invoice ---------- SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.companyID, Set_DocumentType.TransactionType, case when AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode is null then ( select top 1 CUS.TypeCode from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.BusinessPartnerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) else AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode end as TypeCode, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) else ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) end as CustomerID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) else ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) end as BusinessPartnerName, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceSupplierID as SourceID, Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount else AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, case when AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber is not null then Concat(AR_InvoiceHeader.Description ,'PO# ', ((Select top 1 AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader left join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1 Where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 )), 'GRN#', (Select top 1 DocumentNo from INV_StockTransactionHeader left Join AR_InvoiceDetail on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID=AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1 Where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 ) ) else AR_InvoiceHeader.Description end As Comments, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ASCUS ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = ASCUS.CustomerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = ASCUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = ASCUS.PeriodID AND ASCUS.Status = 1 left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.vENDORid AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
left join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID=AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1
--left Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID=AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1
WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate And (SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID =@DocumentTypeiD Or @DocumentTypeiD is Null) and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%HR%' and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%DI-Invoice%'
--and SET_DocumentType.documenttype not like '%Opening%' ) TABInvoice where TABInvoice.companyID in (@CompanyID)
UNION ALL ---------- Payment ---------- SELECT Distinct SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate,AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID as SourceID, (Case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount else AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end) as Amount,
STUFF((SELECT ', ' + PBD.InstrumentNo FROM AP_PaymentBanksDetail PBD WHERE PBD.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InstrumentNo, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, '') + (Case When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments,
case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumbers,
ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT ', ' + AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentDetail WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID ORDER BY AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ), '') as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER Join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
--left JOin AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID=AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID --AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID=AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID --AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID=AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID --AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status=1 left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit'
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate And (SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID =@DocumentTypeiD Or @DocumentTypeiD is Null)
GROUP BY AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate,AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID, AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments UNION ALL
-- PAYMENT -- SINGLE BUSINESS PARTNER CASE SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID as SourceID, (Case when AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType is not null then AP_PaymentHeader.Amount * -1 else AP_PaymentHeader.Amount end) as Amount, STUFF((SELECT ', ' + PBD.InstrumentNo FROM AP_PaymentBanksDetail PBD WHERE PBD.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InstrumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments + (Case When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 0, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumbers, ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT ', ' + AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentDetail WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID ORDER BY AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ), '') as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1

FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID
AND (dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID In (SELECT Distinct DefaultAccountCode FROM dbo.SET_DocumentType WHERE (DocumentType Like 'Advance Against PO%') AND (CompanyID in (@CompanyID)) AND (PeriodID = @PeriodID))) AND (dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit')
LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ASCUS ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = ASCUS.CustomerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = ASCUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = ASCUS.PeriodID AND ASCUS.Status = 1 left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.vENDORid AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate And (SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID =@DocumentTypeiD Or @DocumentTypeiD is Null)
) AS FINTAB GROUP BY DocumentType, CreateDate,CompanyID, CustomerID, NAME, SourceID, InstrumentNo, Comments,DetailNarration, InvoiceNumbers, InvoiceDocumentNo, DocumentNo, DocumentDate, FreightAmount, ForAlhajAmount ,BPType ,GRN_NO,PO_NO ) as TAb -- For Transation type Filter
) as FinalTAB Left Join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_CustomerID = FinalTAB.CustomerID
where FinalTAB.Amount <> 0
) as tab inner join AR_SET_Customer customer on customer.CustomerID = tab.CustomerID inner join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on customer.CustomerCategoryID = Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID group by Name, Year(DocumentDate) ,Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory having Sum(Amount) > 0

-- LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID -- AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID -- AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
