from SAL_InvoiceHeader inner join SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment on SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1
inner join AP_AdvanceSugarPayment on AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PaymentID = SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.AdvancePaymentID and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
left join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID and SET_City.Status = 1
where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceTaxAmount > 0 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND (SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = @CustomerID OR @CustomerID IS NULL) and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType in @DocumentTypeID {0}
Group By AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentNo,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.RecievingDate ,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.FEDAmount,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.FurtherTax,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.WithHoldingTax ,SET_City.CityName,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Quantity,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.AdvanceAmount order by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName asc

data.name: PurchaseRegisterSummaryReportQuery
data.value:
Select FinalTab.VendorName, count(FinalTab.VendorCount) as VendorCount, FinalTab.NTN, FinalTab.STRN, FinalTab.Address , sum(FinalTab.AmountPaid) as AmountPaid ,sum(FinalTab.SalTaxinvolved) as SalTaxinvolved from
(
Select count(tab.VendorCount) as VendorCount, sum(tab.AmountPaid1) as AmountPaid, tab.CustomerName as VendorName, tab.NTNNumber as NTN, tab.STRNNumber as STRN, tab.AddressLine1 as Address, sum(tab.SalTaxinvolved) as SalTaxinvolved from (
SELECT Distinct (ARINVH.InvoiceID) as VendorCount, ARINVH.InvoiceID, (CAST(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmountOnNet as decimal(18,2))) as AmountPaid1, ISNULL(SET_DocumentApprove.CreatedByValue,ARINVH.UpdatedByValue) as AuthorizedBy, ARINVH.CreateDate, ARINVH.CreatedByValue, ARINVH.GrossAmount, ARINVH.InvoiceDate, ARINVH.InvoiceNumber, ARINVH.InvoiceReceivedDate, ARINVH.InvoiceType, ARINVH.VendorID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,C.CustomerName ,C.NTNNumber, c.STRNNumber, C.AddressLine1, sum(CAST(AR_InvoiceDetail.OtherTaxAmountOnNet as decimal(18,2))) as SalTaxinvolved
FROM AR_InvoiceHeader ARINVH
Inner join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = ARINVH.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = ARINVH.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = ARINVH.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = ARINVH.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = ARINVH.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = ARINVH.InvoiceType inner JOIN AR_SET_Customer C on ARINVH.VendorID = C.CustomerID and ARINVH.CompanyID = C.CompanyID and ARINVH.PeriodID = C.PeriodID inner join AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID= ARINVH.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID= ARINVH.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID= ARINVH.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status=1 LEFT JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = ARINVH.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = ARINVH.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = ARINVH.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = ARINVH.InvoiceNumber AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = ( SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE CompanyID = ARINVH.CompanyID AND PeriodID = ARINVH.PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = ARINVH.InvoiceType AND DocumentNo = ARINVH.InvoiceNumber and SET_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = ARINVH.FiscalID ) inner join Set_PeriodCustom on ARINVH.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status= 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
{1}
where ARINVH.Status = 1 and ARINVH.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and ARINVH.CompanyID = @CompanyID and ARINVH.PeriodID = @PeriodID
{AccountCodeFilter} {0}
Group by ARINVH.InvoiceID, ARINVH.AmountPaid ,SET_DocumentApprove.CreatedByValue, ARINVH.UpdatedByValue, ARINVH.CreateDate,ARINVH.CreatedByValue , ARINVH.GrossAmount, ARINVH.InvoiceDate, ARINVH.InvoiceNumber, ARINVH.InvoiceReceivedDate, ARINVH.InvoiceType, ARINVH.VendorID , SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, C.CustomerName, C.NTNNumber, C.STRNNumber, C.AddressLine1 , AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmountOnNet,AR_InvoiceDetail.OtherTaxAmountOnNet
) tab
group by tab.CustomerName,tab.VendorCount,tab.NTNNumber, tab.STRNNumber, tab.AddressLine1
) FinalTab
group by FinalTab.VendorName,FinalTab.NTN, FinalTab.STRN, FinalTab.Address
Order by VendorName

data.name: Query_GetItemWisePurchaseDetailReportData
data.value:
Select AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID,tbl_Suplier.CustomerID as SupplierCode, tbl_Suplier.CustomerName as Supplier , AR_InvoiceDetail.ItemDescription as DetailItemDescription , AR_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced as Quantity, AR_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount as Amount, '-' as Cartage, AR_InvoiceDetail.OtherTaxAmount as SED ,cast(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmountOnNet as decimal(18,2)) as SalesTax , AR_InvoiceDetail.Source as GRNNO, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, INV_Item.Description as Item, INV_Item.ItemID, AR_InvoiceHeader.CostCenterID, AR_InvoiceHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID, AR_InvoiceHeader.DepartmentID, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceReceivedDate
from AR_InvoiceHeader Inner Join AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
left join AR_SET_Customer tbl_Suplier on tbl_Suplier.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID and tbl_Suplier.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and tbl_Suplier.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and tbl_Suplier.Status = 1
Inner Join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = AR_InvoiceDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and INV_Item.Status = 1
Inner Join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID and SET_ItemCatalog.Status = 1
where AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate
{0}

data.name: Query_Report_APBillReport_ForSKU
data.value:
Select * from (
select InvoiceType, Comments, InvoiceDate, InvoiceDateMin, InvoiceNumber, VendorID, CustomerName, sum(GrossAmount) as GrossAmount,OtherTax,OtherAmount, sum(TaxAmount) TaxAmount, sum(NetAmount) NetAmount, PaymentTerms, GRN, PurchaseOrderNumber, VendorReferenceNumber, Status, ( SELECT isnull(sum(Round(ARINVD.Amount, 2)), 0) FROM AR_InvoiceHeader ARINVH left JOIN AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail ARINVD ON ARINVD.InvoiceHeaderID = ARINVH.InvoiceID AND ARINVD.CompanyID = ARINVH.CompanyID AND ARINVD.PeriodID = ARINVH.PeriodID AND ARINVD.Status = 1 WHERE ARINVH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND ARINVH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND ARINVH.[Status] = 1 AND ARINVH.StatusCode = 1 AND ARINVH.InvoiceDate <= FINTAB.InvoiceDateMin AND ARINVH.VendorID = FINTAB.VendorID AND ARINVH.InvoiceType in ( SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID FROM SET_DocumentType where SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (SELECT MenuID FROM ApplicationMenu where MenuPath = '/AR/Transaction/Invoice_Transaction_frm.aspx') AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'DI-opening' ) ) as 'Opening' ,AdvanceAmount ,PaymentAmount from ( SELECT AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AS InvoiceTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, MIN(AR_INVH.InvoiceDate) as InvoiceDateMin, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID, C.CustomerName, SET_Currency.CurrencyName,
case when AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount is not null then case when isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID,0) = 1 then Round(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount, 2) *-1 else Round(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount, 2) end
else case when isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID,0) = 1 then Round(AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount, 2) *-1 else Round(AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount, 2) end
end as GrossAmount,
Isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherAmount,0) as OtherTax ,ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount,0) as OtherAmount
--,ISNULL(((Round(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount, 2) * isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, 0))) / 100, 0) as TaxAmount,
,case when isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID,0) = 1 then ISNULL(((Round(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount, 2) * isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, 0))) / 100, 0) *-1 else ISNULL(((Round(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount, 2) * isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, 0))) / 100, 0) end as TaxAmount,
(Case when AR_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount is not null then
case when isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID,0) = 1 then AR_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount *-1 else AR_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount end
else AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount end) as NetAmount,
SET_Term.Description As [PaymentTerms], [Source] as 'GRN', AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber AS PurchaseOrderNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber ,( Case when AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode=1 then 'Approved' when AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode=5 then 'Inprocess' else '' end ) as Status ,( SELECT ISNULL(SUM(GL_TransactionDetail.Amount), 0) FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID WHERE GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID in ( SELECT Distinct DefaultAccountCode FROM SET_DocumentType WHERE DocumentType Like '%Advance Against PO%' AND CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.periodid ) AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' ) as AdvanceAmount
,(select ISNULL(SUM(AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Amount),0) from AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail where AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 and InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID ) as PaymentAmount
FROM AR_InvoiceHeader LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader AR_INVH on AR_INVH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_INVH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_INVH.Status = 1 AND AR_INVH.InvoiceDate < @FromDate AND AR_INVH.VendorID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail on AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType INNER JOIN SET_Currency ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID = SET_Currency.CurrencyID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer C ON AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = C.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = C.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID = C.CustomerID LEFT JOIN SET_Term ON AR_InvoiceHeader.TermsID = SET_Term.TermID left join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID {0} Group By [AR_InvoiceHeader].[InvoiceType], INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments, [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentType], [AR_InvoiceHeader].[InvoiceDate], [AR_InvoiceHeader].[InvoiceNumber], [AR_InvoiceHeader].[VendorID], C.[CustomerName], AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ,[SET_Currency].[CurrencyName], [AR_InvoiceDetail].[GrossAmount], [AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail].[Amount], [AR_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount], [AR_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount], [SET_Term].[Description], [AR_InvoiceDetail].[Source], [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[DocumentNumber], [AR_InvoiceHeader].[VendorReferenceNumber] ,AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherAmount , AR_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount ,AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode ,AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID ,AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID ,AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID ,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber ,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType ,AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID ,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID )FINTAB group by InvoiceType,Comments, InvoiceDate, InvoiceDateMin,OtherTax,OtherAmount, InvoiceNumber, VendorID, CustomerName, PaymentTerms, GRN, PurchaseOrderNumber, VendorReferenceNumber,Status ,AdvanceAmount ,PaymentAmount
union all
select InvoiceType, Comments, InvoiceDate, InvoiceDateMin, InvoiceNumber, VendorID, CustomerName, sum(GrossAmount) as GrossAmount,OtherTax,OtherAmount, sum(TaxAmount) TaxAmount, sum(NetAmount) NetAmount, PaymentTerms, GRN, PurchaseOrderNumber, VendorReferenceNumber, Status, ( SELECT isnull(sum(Round(ARINVD.Amount, 2)), 0) FROM AR_InvoiceHeader ARINVH left JOIN AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail ARINVD ON ARINVD.InvoiceHeaderID = ARINVH.InvoiceID AND ARINVD.CompanyID = ARINVH.CompanyID AND ARINVD.PeriodID = ARINVH.PeriodID AND ARINVD.Status = 1 WHERE ARINVH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND ARINVH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND ARINVH.[Status] = 1 AND ARINVH.StatusCode = 1 AND ARINVH.InvoiceDate <= FINTAB.InvoiceDateMin AND ARINVH.VendorID = FINTAB.VendorID AND ARINVH.InvoiceType in ( SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID FROM SET_DocumentType where SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (SELECT MenuID FROM ApplicationMenu where MenuPath = '/AR/Transaction/Invoice_Transaction_frm.aspx') AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'DI-opening' ) ) as 'Opening' ,AdvanceAmount ,PaymentAmount
from ( SELECT AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AS InvoiceTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, MIN(AR_INVH.InvoiceDate) as InvoiceDateMin, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID, C.CustomerName, SET_Currency.CurrencyName,
case when AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount is not null then case when isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID,0) = 1 then Round(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount, 2) *-1 else Round(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount, 2) end
else case when isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID,0) = 1 then Round(AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount, 2) *-1 else Round(AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount, 2) end
end as GrossAmount,
Isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherAmount,0) as OtherTax ,ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount,0) as OtherAmount
--,ISNULL(((Round(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount, 2) * isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, 0))) / 100, 0) as TaxAmount,
,case when isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID,0) = 1 then ISNULL(((Round(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount, 2) * isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, 0))) / 100, 0) *-1 else ISNULL(((Round(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount, 2) * isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, 0))) / 100, 0) end as TaxAmount,
(Case when AR_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount is not null then
case when isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID,0) = 1 then AR_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount *-1 else AR_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount end
else AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount end) as NetAmount,
SET_Term.Description As [PaymentTerms], [Source] as 'GRN', AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber AS PurchaseOrderNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber ,( Case when AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode=1 then 'Approved' when AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode=5 then 'Inprocess' else '' end ) as Status ,( SELECT ISNULL(SUM(GL_TransactionDetail.Amount), 0) FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID WHERE GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID in ( SELECT Distinct DefaultAccountCode FROM SET_DocumentType WHERE DocumentType Like '%Advance Against PO%' AND CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.periodid ) AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' ) as AdvanceAmount ,( select ISNULL(SUM(AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Amount),0) from AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail where AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 and InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID ) as PaymentAmount
FROM AR_InvoiceHeader LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader AR_INVH on AR_INVH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_INVH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_INVH.Status = 1 AND AR_INVH.InvoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND AR_INVH.VendorID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail on AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType INNER JOIN SET_Currency ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID = SET_Currency.CurrencyID inner JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID
inner JOIN AR_SET_Customer C ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = C.CustomerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = C.PeriodID LEFT JOIN SET_Term ON AR_InvoiceHeader.TermsID = SET_Term.TermID left join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and isnull(AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Narration,'') != 'GST' {0}
Group By [AR_InvoiceHeader].[InvoiceType], INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments, [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentType], [AR_InvoiceHeader].[InvoiceDate], [AR_InvoiceHeader].[InvoiceNumber], [AR_InvoiceHeader].[VendorID], C.[CustomerName], AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ,[SET_Currency].[CurrencyName], [AR_InvoiceDetail].[GrossAmount], [AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail].[Amount], [AR_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount], [AR_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount], [SET_Term].[Description], [AR_InvoiceDetail].[Source], [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].[DocumentNumber], [AR_InvoiceHeader].[VendorReferenceNumber] ,AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherAmount , AR_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount ,AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode ,AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID ,AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID ,AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID ,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber ,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType ,AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID ,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID )FINTAB group by InvoiceType,Comments, InvoiceDate, InvoiceDateMin,OtherTax,OtherAmount, InvoiceNumber, VendorID, CustomerName, PaymentTerms, GRN, PurchaseOrderNumber, VendorReferenceNumber,Status,AdvanceAmount ,PaymentAmount
) FinalTab
{1}

else case when isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID,0) = 1 then Round(AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount, 2) *-1 else Round(AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount, 2) end

,(select ISNULL(SUM(AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Amount),0) from AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail where AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 and InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID ) as PaymentAmount ,{1} as PaidUnpaid FROM AR_InvoiceHeader LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader AR_INVH on AR_INVH.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_INVH.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_INVH.Status = 1 AND AR_INVH.InvoiceDate < @FromDate AND AR_INVH.VendorID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID data.name: Query_CustomerAgingVendor2
data.value:
select tab.DocumentType,tab.Description, tab.SupplierName, tab.CurrencyName, tab.InvoiceNumber, tab.invoiceDate,tab.Days, Sum(tab.InvoiceAmount) as InvoiceAmount, (abs(Sum(tab.Amount)) - sum(tab.PaymentAmount)) As Amount, convert(decimal, sum(tab.PaymentAmount)) as PaymentAmount, (abs(Sum(tab.InvoiceAmount)) - sum(tab.PaymentAmount)) as Balance, tab.CustomerID, tab.ToNoOfDays , tab.SourceID , tab.BrokerName, tab.BrokerID from ( ---------- Sale Invoice ---------- SELECT distinct SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, 'PKR' as CurrencyName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate, max(SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid * -1) as InvoiceAmount, max(SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid * -1) as Amount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays, datediff(day, SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate, getdate()) as Days, --sum(isnull(AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Amount, 0)) as PaymentAmount , (select isnull(sum(AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetailinner.Amount),0) from AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetailinner inner join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.ReceiptTransactionID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetailinner.ReceiptHeaderID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.StatusCode = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.Status = 1 inner join SAL_InvoiceDetail SAL_InvoiceDetailinner on SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetailinner.InvoiceHeaderID inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail INV_StockTransactionDetailinner on INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.StockHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.StockDetailID
where SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID) as PaymentAmount, SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID as SOID , '' as SourceID ,AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerName as BrokerName ,AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerID as BrokerID FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1
inner join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_OrderDetail on SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID and SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID and SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_OrderDetail.Status = 1

left join AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail on AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Status = 1

union all -- Direct Receipt select innertab.DocumentType,innertab.Description,innertab.SupplierName,innertab.CurrencyName,innertab.InvoiceNumber, innertab.invoiceDate,sum(innertab.InvoiceAmount) as InvoiceAmount,max(innertab.InvoiceAmount) as Amount, innertab.CustomerID,innertab.ToNoOfDays,innertab.Days,max(innertab.PaymentAmount) as PaymentAmount, innertab.SOID,innertab.SourceID,innertab.BrokerName,innertab.BrokerID from ( SELECT distinct SET_DocumentTypeSO.DocumentType, SET_Bucket.Description,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, 'PKR' as CurrencyName, SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo as InvoiceNumber ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate as invoiceDate --,sum(sal_invoicedetail.GrossAmount) as InvoiceAmount, ,isnull((select isnull(sum(isnull(sal_invoicedetailinner.NetAmount,0)),0) from SAL_InvoiceDetail SAL_InvoiceDetailinner inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail INV_StockTransactionDetailinner on INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.StockHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.StockDetailID where INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.TransactionDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID),0) as InvoiceAmount,
0 as Amount,
AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays , datediff(day,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,getdate()) as Days,

where INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.TransactionDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID) as PaymentAmount , '' as SOID , AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.SourceHeaderID as SourceID , AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerName as BrokerName ,AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerID as BrokerID FROM AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 {0}
inner join AR_SET_Customer AR_SET_CustomerBroker on AR_SET_CustomerBroker.customerid = AR_SET_Customer.brokerid and AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID {1}
left join sal_contractheader on sal_contractheader.contractid = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Sourceheaderid and sal_contractheader.companyid = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.companyid and sal_contractheader.periodid = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.periodid and sal_contractheader.status = 1

left JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID = [SAL_ContractDetail].ContractDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID AND SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID= SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status = 1
left Join [SAL_OrderHeader] on [SAL_OrderHeader].OrderID= SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].Status=1

left JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Dodetailid AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderid AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0) < 0
left join SET_DocumentType as SET_DocumentType2 on SET_DocumentType2.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType2.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType2.Status = 1 and SET_DocumentType2.DocumentType like '%Delivery%'
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = @BusinessPartnerType OR @BusinessPartnerType IS NULL) Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID IS NULL) and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%advance against%'
left Join SET_DocumentType SET_DocumentTypeSO On SET_DocumentTypeSO.DocumentTypeID = SAL_Contractheader.SaleContractTypeID and SET_DocumentTypeSO.CompanyID = SAL_Contractheader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentTypeSO.PeriodID = SAL_Contractheader.PeriodID AND (SET_DocumentTypeSO.GroupID = null OR null IS NULL)
WHERE AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 2 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalDate is null and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments is null And (DATEDIFF(day, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) group by SET_Bucket.Description,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName , SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays,SET_DocumentTypeSO.DocumentType,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.SourceHeaderID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID, AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerName,AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerID )innertab
group by innertab.DocumentType,innertab.Description,innertab.SupplierName,innertab.CurrencyName,innertab.InvoiceNumber, innertab.invoiceDate, innertab.CustomerID,innertab.ToNoOfDays,innertab.Days, innertab.SOID,innertab.SourceID,innertab.BrokerName,innertab.BrokerID
union all -------- Receipt Suppliers ---------- SELECT distinct SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, 'PKR' as CurrencyName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo as InvoiceNumber ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate as invoiceDate, 0 as InvoiceAmount, 0 as Amount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays , datediff(day,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,getdate()) as Days, case AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then isnull(sum(AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount),0) *-1 when 'credit' then isnull(sum(AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount),0) else 0 end as PaymentAmount , '' as SOID , '' as SourceID ,AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerName as BrokerName ,AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerID as BrokerID
FROM AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 INNER Join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 {0} inner join AR_SET_Customer AR_SET_CustomerBroker on AR_SET_CustomerBroker.customerid = AR_SET_Customer.brokerid and AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID {1} INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = @BusinessPartnerType OR @BusinessPartnerType IS NULL) Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID IS NULL) WHERE AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 2 And (DATEDIFF(day, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) --and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalDate is null and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments is null group by SET_Bucket.Description,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName , AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays,AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerName ,AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerID )as Tab INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = Tab.CustomerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 2 Group By tab.Description, tab.SupplierName, data.name: Query_APWithHoldingTax_RSM
data.value:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType InvoiceTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType InvoiceType, AR_InvoiceHeader .InvoiceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TaxCalculationAmount InvoiceAmount, AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo AS PaymentDocNo, PaymentType.DocumentType AS PaymentType, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate AS PaymentDate, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount AS PaymentAmount ,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description,SET_TaxType.TaxTypeName ,CASE WHEN SET_TaxType.TaxTypeName LIKE '%income tax%' THEN AR_SET_Tax.TaxRate ELSE 0 END AS FBRTaxRate ,CASE WHEN SET_TaxType.TaxTypeName LIKE '%income tax%' THEN AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END AS FBRTaxAmount
,CASE WHEN SET_TaxType.TaxTypeName LIKE '%sst%' THEN AR_SET_Tax.TaxRate ELSE 0 END AS SRBTaxRate ,CASE WHEN SET_TaxType.TaxTypeName LIKE '%sst%' THEN AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END AS SRBTaxAmount
,CASE WHEN SET_TaxType.TaxTypeName LIKE '%sales tax%' THEN AR_SET_Tax.TaxRate ELSE 0 END AS URTaxRate ,CASE WHEN SET_TaxType.TaxTypeName LIKE '%sales tax%' THEN AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END AS URTaxAmount
FROM AR_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail ON AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
--LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = AR_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID -- AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = AR_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID -- AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID
LEFT JOIN ap_paymentinvoicesDetail ON ap_paymentinvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND ap_paymentinvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND ap_paymentinvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND ap_paymentinvoicesDetail.status = 1
LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentHeader On AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = ap_paymentinvoicesDetail.CompanyID And AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = ap_paymentinvoicesDetail.PeriodID and ap_paymentinvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentHeader.status = 1
LEFT JOIN SET_DocumentType PaymentType ON PaymentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND PaymentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND PaymentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID
INNER join AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.companyID = AP_PaymentHeader.companyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.periodID = AP_PaymentHeader.periodID and AP_PaymentHeader.status = 1
INNER JOIN AP_Payment_AccountsDetail ON AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID AND AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.status = 1
LEFT JOIN dbo.GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID

,CASE WHEN SET_TaxType.TaxTypeName LIKE '%sst%' THEN AR_SET_Tax.TaxRate ELSE 0 END AS SRBTaxRate ,CASE WHEN SET_TaxType.TaxTypeName LIKE '%sst%' THEN AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END AS SRBTaxAmount
,CASE WHEN SET_TaxType.TaxTypeName LIKE '%sales tax%' THEN AR_SET_Tax.TaxRate ELSE 0 END AS URTaxRate ,CASE WHEN SET_TaxType.TaxTypeName LIKE '%sales tax%' THEN AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END AS URTaxAmount FROM AP_PaymentHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID

INNER JOIN AP_Payment_AccountsDetail ON AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID AND AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.status = 1
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; WITH CTE_InvoiceAmount AS ( SELECT CompanyID, CustomerID, dbo.GetNetAmount(CompanyID, CustomerID, @AsOnDate) AS ReceiptAdvance FROM AR_SET_Customer WHERE PeriodID = 1 AND Status = 1 {3} --and BrokerID =100001 GROUP BY CompanyID, CustomerID
)
select * from ( SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_Bucket.Description, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays, DATEDIFF(DAY, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, GETDATE()) AS Days, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerName AS BrokerName, --SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid AS InvoiceAmount, ( select sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount) from SAL_InvoiceDetail where SAL_InvoiceDetail.invoiceheaderid = SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoiceid and SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.periodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.periodID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
) as InvoiceAmount, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,
--dbo.GetNetAmount(SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,@AsOnDate) AS ReceiptAdvance isnull(ia.ReceiptAdvance,0) as ReceiptAdvance
FROM dbo.SAL_InvoiceHeader LEFT JOIN CTE_InvoiceAmount ia ON ia.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID and ia.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN dbo.AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 {0} INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID AND SET_Bucket.Status = 1 AND SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer AR_SET_CustomerBroker ON AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.BrokerID {2} INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID --INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID -- AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID -- AND (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = @BusinessPartnerType OR @BusinessPartnerType IS NULL)
WHERE SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate <= @AsOnDate And (DATEDIFF(day, SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID IS NULL) AND (SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID OR @DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT distinct SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_Bucket.Description, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays, DATEDIFF(DAY, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, GETDATE()) AS Days, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerName AS BrokerName, --SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid AS InvoiceAmount, ISNULL(( select sum( CASE WHEN suppDtl.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN suppDtl.Amount ELSE suppDtl.Amount *-1 END ) from dbo.Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail suppDtl where suppDtl.invoiceheaderid = SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoiceid and suppDtl.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and suppDtl.periodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.periodID and suppDtl.Status = 1 AND suppDtl.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID ),0) AS InvoiceAmount, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,
--dbo.GetNetAmount(SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,@AsOnDate) AS ReceiptAdvance isnull(ia.ReceiptAdvance,0) as ReceiptAdvance
FROM dbo.SAL_InvoiceHeader
INNER JOIN Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail On Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status=1 LEFT JOIN CTE_InvoiceAmount ia ON ia.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID and ia.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN dbo.AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 {0} INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID AND SET_Bucket.Status = 1 AND SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer AR_SET_CustomerBroker ON AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.BrokerID {2} INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID --INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID -- AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID -- AND (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = @BusinessPartnerType OR @BusinessPartnerType IS NULL) WHERE SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate <= @AsOnDate And (DATEDIFF(day, SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID IS NULL) AND (SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID OR @DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_Bucket.Description, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays, DATEDIFF(DAY, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, GETDATE()) AS Days, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerName AS BrokerName, --AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount AS InvoiceAmount, ( select sum(AR_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount) from AR_InvoiceDetail where AR_InvoiceDetail.invoiceheaderid = AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceid and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.periodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.periodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 ) + ISNULL(( select sum( CASE WHEN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' THEN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount ELSE AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount *-1 END ) from dbo.AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.invoiceheaderid = AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceid and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.periodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.periodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Narration != 'GST'),0) as InvoiceAmount, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,
--dbo.GetNetAmount(AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,@AsOnDate) AS ReceiptAdvance isnull(ia.ReceiptAdvance,0) as ReceiptAdvance FROM AR_InvoiceHeader LEFT JOIN CTE_InvoiceAmount ia ON ia.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID and ia.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 {0} INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID AND SET_Bucket.Status = 1 AND SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 left JOIN AR_SET_Customer AR_SET_CustomerBroker ON AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.BrokerID
--INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID -- AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID -- AND (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = @BusinessPartnerType OR @BusinessPartnerType IS NULL) Where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate <= @AsOnDate AND (DATEDIFF(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID IS NULL) AND (SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID OR @DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 {2} UNION ALL
SELECT distinct SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_Bucket.Description, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays, DATEDIFF(DAY, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, GETDATE()) AS Days, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID AS VendorID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerName AS BrokerName, --AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount AS InvoiceAmount, ISNULL(( select sum(AR_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount) from AR_InvoiceDetail where AR_InvoiceDetail.invoiceheaderid = AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceid and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.periodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.periodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 ),0) + ISNULL(( select sum( CASE WHEN suppDtl.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN suppDtl.Amount ELSE suppDtl.Amount *-1 END ) from dbo.AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail suppDtl where suppDtl.invoiceheaderid = AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceid and suppDtl.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and suppDtl.periodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.periodID and suppDtl.Status = 1 AND suppDtl.SupplierID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID AND suppDtl.Narration != 'GST'),0) as InvoiceAmount, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,
--dbo.GetNetAmount(AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,@AsOnDate) AS ReceiptAdvance isnull(ia.ReceiptAdvance,0) as ReceiptAdvance FROM AR_InvoiceHeader
INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN CTE_InvoiceAmount ia ON ia.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID and ia.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID INNER JOIN AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 {0} INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID AND SET_Bucket.Status = 1 AND SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 left JOIN AR_SET_Customer AR_SET_CustomerBroker ON AR_SET_CustomerBroker.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.BrokerID
--INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID -- AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID -- AND (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = @BusinessPartnerType OR @BusinessPartnerType IS NULL) Where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate <= @AsOnDate AND (DATEDIFF(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID IS NULL) AND (SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID OR @DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID,0) = 0 {2} )as tab ORDER BY CustomerID,InvoiceDate

select tab.Description, tab.SupplierName, tab.CurrencyName, Sum(tab.Amount) As Amount, tab.CustomerID, tab.ToNoOfDays from ( ---------- Purchase Invoice ---------- SELECT distinct SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, 'PKR' as CurrencyName, (select sum(NetAmount) from AR_InvoiceDetail where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status= 1
) * -1 as Amount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName in ('Vendor') WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @companyId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId And (DATEDIFF(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) {0} union all ---------- Purchase Invoice Suppliers ---------- SELECT distinct SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, 'PKR' as CurrencyName, Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount else AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end as Amount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 inner JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName in ('Vendor') WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @companyId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId And (DATEDIFF(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) and isnull(AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.narration,'') != 'GST' {0} union all ---------- Payments ---------- SELECT SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, 'PKR' as CurrencyName, case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%vendor invoice%' then sum(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) else Sum((Case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount else AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end)) end as Amount ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays FROM AP_PaymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader .DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader .CompanyID INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 INNER Join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @companyId
And (DATEDIFF(day, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 1 and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%vendor invoice%' and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 {0} group by SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays ,AP_PaymentHeader .DocumentNo ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType
union all ---------- Payments Vendor Invoice ---------- SELECT SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, 'PKR' as CurrencyName,
Sum(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount) as Amount ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays FROM AP_PaymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader .DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader .CompanyID INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 INNER Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @companyId
And (DATEDIFF(day, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 1 {0} and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%vendor invoice%' and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 group by SET_Bucket.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, SET_Bucket.ToNoOfDays ,AP_PaymentHeader .DocumentNo ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType
)as Tab INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = Tab.CustomerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 1
Group By tab.Description, tab.SupplierName, tab.CurrencyName, tab.CustomerID, tab.ToNoOfDays
Order by tab.ToNoOfDays asc

select *,( Case when (DocumentType like 'Sales%Invoice%' or DocumentType like 'DI%Customer%' ) then -- 0 isnull((select max(InvoiceHeaderID) from dbo.AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail where invoiceheaderid = FinalTAB.SourceID),SourceID) when DocumentType like 'Receipt%Against%' then --0 (select max(InvoiceHeaderID) from dbo.AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail where InvoiceHeaderID= FinalTAB.SourceID) --end
when (DocumentType like 'Advance Against SO%' or DocumentType like 'Direct%' )then --0 (select max(ReceiptTransactionID) from dbo.AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader where ReceiptTransactionID= FinalTAB.SourceID) end
)InvoiceGroup , (Case when DocumentType like '%(Op%' then 0 --When DocumentType like '%Direct%' --then 0 when (Reversal is not null) then -1 when (DocumentType like 'Sale%Invoice%' or DocumentType like 'DI%Customer%') then DocumentNo when (DocumentType like 'Advance Against SO%' or DocumentType like 'Direct%') then DocumentNo
else -1 end) GroupNo
from (
select * from (

) as InvoiceAmount, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,

FROM ( SELECT SUM(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount) AS TotalAmount FROM dbo.AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = (SELECT SUM(TotalAmount) AS TotalSum
FROM ( SELECT SUM(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount) AS TotalAmount FROM dbo.AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID IS NULL) inner JOIN dbo.AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 {0} INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID AND SET_Bucket.Status = 1 AND SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 {2} --INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID -- AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID -- AND (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = @BusinessPartnerType OR @BusinessPartnerType IS NULL) WHERE AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (DATEDIFF(day, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate, GETDATE()) BETWEEN FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays OR (tonoofdays IS NULL AND DATEDIFF(day, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND (SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID OR @DocumentTypeID IS NULL)
UNION ALL -- Direct Receipt SELECT SUM(AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount) AS TotalAmount FROM dbo.AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail ON AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID IS NULL) INNER JOIN dbo.AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 {0} INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID AND SET_Bucket.Status = 1 AND SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 {2} --INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID -- AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID -- AND (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = @BusinessPartnerType OR @BusinessPartnerType IS NULL) WHERE AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (DATEDIFF(day, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate, GETDATE()) BETWEEN FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays OR (tonoofdays IS NULL AND DATEDIFF(day, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) AND (SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID OR @DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT SUM(DebitMinusCredit) AS TotalAmount FROM ( SELECT AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, GL_TransactionDetail.Amount AS DebitMinusCredit
FROM AP_PaymentHeader
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = AP_PaymentHeader.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.status = 1
INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID
AND dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID In (SELECT Distinct DefaultAccountCode FROM dbo.SET_DocumentType WHERE DocumentType Like 'Advance Against PO%' AND CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID) AND dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit'
INNER JOIN dbo.SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = null OR null IS NULL)
INNER JOIN dbo.AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentHeader.Vendorid AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 {0}
WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = 1 AND (SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = null OR null IS NULL) and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Advance Against PO%'
union all
SELECT AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.Amount AS DebitMinusCredit
FROM AP_PaymentHeader
INNER JOIN dbo.SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = null OR null IS NULL)
INNER JOIN dbo.AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 {0}
WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = 1 AND (SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = null OR null IS NULL) and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Payment Against Vendor%'
union all
SELECT AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Advance Against PO%' or SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Payment Against Vendor%' or SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%opening%' then (ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' THEN AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END))) *-1 else (ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' THEN AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END))) end AS DebitMinusCredit FROM dbo.AP_PaymentSupplierDetail INNER JOIN dbo.AP_PaymentHeader ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID INNER JOIN dbo.SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID IS NULL) --INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID -- AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID -- AND (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = @BusinessPartnerType OR @BusinessPartnerType IS NULL) INNER JOIN dbo.AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 {1} {2} WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID OR @DocumentTypeID IS NULL) GROUP BY AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ) AS DebitCreditSubquery ) AS CombinedQuery ) AS ReceiptAdvance
FROM AR_InvoiceHeader
INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 {0} INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID AND SET_Bucket.Status = 1 AND SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 {2} Where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate <= @AsOnDate AND (DATEDIFF(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, GETDATE()) between FromNoOfDays AND tonoofdays or (tonoofdays is null AND DATEDIFF(day, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, GETDATE()) >= FromNoOfDays)) AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID IS NULL) AND (SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID OR @DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 And AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceid not in (select InvoiceHeaderID from AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1)
)as tab ORDER BY CustomerID,InvoiceDate

data.name: Query_GetInvoiceAndGLDetails
data.value:
Select AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber,GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID From AR_InvoiceHeader
Inner Join GL_TransactionHeader On AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID
Where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID And AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber = @SalaryHeaderID
